title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
title_zh: 表象之下：谈论智能体进化时我们忽视了什么

paragraphs.en: 1 University of Science and Technology of China 2 University of California, Berkeley 3 Simple Agent Lab 4 Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence 5 Shanghai Jiaotong University * Equal contribution. † \dagger Corresponding authors.
paragraphs.zh: 1 中国科学技术大学 2 加州大学伯克利分校 3 Simple Agent Lab 4 北京通用人工智能研究院 5 上海交通大学 * 同等贡献。† \dagger 通讯作者。

paragraphs.en: Agent harness evolution enables recursive self-improvement (RSI) without updating model weights. We examine whether higher benchmark scores yield reliable, efficient, and transferable improvement. We evaluate four methods across harnesses, general and coding tasks. Repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions, and admission replays reveal recurring patterns. All sixteen evolved agents gain previously uncovered tasks while losing previously covered ones. In one general-task case, reliability rises by 5.2 points despite losing ten previously covered tasks. Most reliability gains also increase deployment cost. Specific changes usually outperform generic reminders, but their benefits can change when combined. The highest-scoring agent does not yield the largest mean improvement in any of our four pools, and stricter admission can discard useful alternatives. Transfer selectively preserves gains: coverage usually falls on the general-task target across both harness types and paradigms, but rises on the coding target with the outer-layer-only harness. These findings motivate preservation-aware evaluation, tested decision rules, and explicit applicability conditions. As a constructive follow-up, EvoAudit turns these diagnostics into revisions of select , analyze , mutate , and gate , achieving the best performance.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架的演化使得无需更新模型权重的递归自我改进（RSI）成为可能。 我们检验更高的基准分数是否能带来可靠、高效且可迁移的改进。 我们在不同框架、通用任务和编码任务上评估四种方法。 重复评估、受控的智能体扩展、组件干预以及准入重放揭示了反复出现的规律。 全部十六个演化后的智能体都获得了先前未覆盖的任务，同时失去了先前已覆盖的任务。 在一个通用任务的案例中，尽管失去了十个先前已覆盖的任务，可靠性仍提升了5.2分。 大多数可靠性提升也会增加部署成本。 具体修改通常优于泛泛的提醒，但其收益在组合使用时可能发生变化。 得分最高的智能体并未在我们四个任务池中的任何一个带来最大的平均改进，而更严格的准入可能丢弃有用的备选方案。 迁移会选择性地保留收益：在两种框架类型和两种范式下，通用任务目标上的覆盖率通常下降，但仅在仅使用外层框架时，编码任务目标上的覆盖率上升。 这些发现促使我们采用注重保留的评估、经过检验的决策规则以及明确的适用条件。 作为建设性的后续工作，EvoAudit 将这些诊断结果转化为对 select、analyze、mutate 和 gate 的修订，取得了最佳性能。

sents.en: Agent harness evolution enables recursive self-improvement (RSI) without updating model weights.
sents.zh: 智能体框架的演化使得无需更新模型权重的递归自我改进（RSI）成为可能。

sents.en: We examine whether higher benchmark scores yield reliable, efficient, and transferable improvement.
sents.zh: 我们检验更高的基准分数是否能带来可靠、高效且可迁移的改进。

sents.en: We evaluate four methods across harnesses, general and coding tasks.
sents.zh: 我们在不同框架、通用任务和编码任务上评估四种方法。

sents.en: Repeated evaluations, controlled agent expansion, component interventions, and admission replays reveal recurring patterns.
sents.zh: 重复评估、受控的智能体扩展、组件干预以及准入重放揭示了反复出现的规律。

sents.en: All sixteen evolved agents gain previously uncovered tasks while losing previously covered ones.
sents.zh: 全部十六个演化后的智能体都获得了先前未覆盖的任务，同时失去了先前已覆盖的任务。

sents.en: In one general-task case, reliability rises by 5.2 points despite losing ten previously covered tasks.
sents.zh: 在一个通用任务的案例中，尽管失去了十个先前已覆盖的任务，可靠性仍提升了5.2分。

sents.en: Most reliability gains also increase deployment cost.
sents.zh: 大多数可靠性提升也会增加部署成本。

sents.en: Specific changes usually outperform generic reminders, but their benefits can change when combined.
sents.zh: 具体修改通常优于泛泛的提醒，但其收益在组合使用时可能发生变化。

sents.en: The highest-scoring agent does not yield the largest mean improvement in any of our four pools, and stricter admission can discard useful alternatives.
sents.zh: 得分最高的智能体并未在我们四个任务池中的任何一个带来最大的平均改进，而更严格的准入可能丢弃有用的备选方案。

sents.en: Transfer selectively preserves gains: coverage usually falls on the general-task target across both harness types and paradigms, but rises on the coding target with the outer-layer-only harness.
sents.zh: 迁移会选择性地保留收益：在两种框架类型和两种范式下，通用任务目标上的覆盖率通常下降，但仅在仅使用外层框架时，编码任务目标上的覆盖率上升。

sents.en: These findings motivate preservation-aware evaluation, tested decision rules, and explicit applicability conditions.
sents.zh: 这些发现促使我们采用注重保留的评估、经过检验的决策规则以及明确的适用条件。

sents.en: As a constructive follow-up, EvoAudit turns these diagnostics into revisions of select , analyze , mutate , and gate , achieving the best performance.
sents.zh: 作为建设性的后续工作，EvoAudit 将这些诊断结果转化为对 select、analyze、mutate 和 gate 的修订，取得了最佳性能。

paragraphs.en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) studies agents that iteratively revise their own designs based on experience ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Agent harness evolution offers a concrete form of this idea for language-model agents: it keeps model weights fixed while persistently changing the surrounding system that shapes observations and turns model outputs into actions ( Lin et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Depending on the harness, these changes can target prompts, skills, tool interfaces, orchestration, or source code, going beyond static prompting and memory-based adaptation ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Recent frameworks close the loop between execution, diagnosis, mutation, and evaluation, reporting gains on standard benchmarks ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Shang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . These benchmark gains suggest that harness evolution is a promising avenue for pursuing RSI.
paragraphs.zh: 递归自我改进（RSI）研究的是智能体根据经验迭代地修改自身设计（Zelikman et al., 2024; Hu et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2026b）。 智能体框架演化为语言模型智能体提供了这一理念的一种具体形式：它保持模型权重不变，同时持续改变周围系统，该系统负责塑造观测并将模型输出转化为动作（Lin et al., 2026a; Zhang et al., 2026c）。 取决于具体框架，这些改变可以针对提示、技能、工具接口、编排或源代码，超越了静态提示和基于记忆的适应（Shinn et al., 2023; Wang et al., 2024）。 近期的框架将执行、诊断、变异和评估之间的闭环连接起来，并在标准基准上报告了收益（Hu et al., 2025; Shang et al., 2025; Zhang et al., 2025a）。 这些基准收益表明，框架演化是追求RSI的一条有前景的途径。

paragraphs.en: However, a higher overall benchmark score do not mean a more useful agent. It averages over tasks and trials, so newly solved tasks can conceal lost ones, while deployment cost and performance beyond the tasks that guided evolution remain unseen ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Kapoor et al., 2025 ) . Relying on that score alone can favor brittle or expensive agent versions and mistake adaptation to the tasks used during evolution for general improvement. Meaningful progress instead requires gains that are reliable across tasks, affordable to deploy, and effective on tasks that did not guide evolution. We aim to explain which persistent harness changes produce useful gains and how evolution generates and preserves them.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，总体基准分数更高并不意味着更实用的智能体。 它对任务和多次试验取平均，因此新解决的任务可能掩盖退步的任务，而部署成本以及演化所用任务之外的性能则无从体现（Gao et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026b；Kapoor et al., 2025）。 仅依赖该分数可能偏向脆弱或昂贵的智能体版本，并将对演化所用任务的适应误认为是普遍性提升。 真正有意义的进展需要的是跨任务可靠、部署成本低廉、且在未引导演化的任务上依然有效的收益。 我们旨在解释哪些持续的 harness 变更能产生有用的收益，以及演化如何生成并保留这些收益。

sents.zh: 真正有意义的进展需要的是跨任务可靠、部署成本低廉、且在未引导演化的任务上依然有效的收益。

sents.zh: 我们旨在解释哪些持续的 harness 变更能产生有用的收益，以及演化如何生成并保留这些收益。

paragraphs.en: We organize our empirical investigation around three research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们围绕三个研究问题组织实证研究：

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (Phenomenology): Does agent evolution yield reliable and efficient improvements, or does it suffer from task-coverage trade-offs and hidden costs?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（现象学）：智能体演化是否能带来可靠且高效的改进，还是会受到任务覆盖权衡和隐性成本的影响？

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Generalization): Do the gains achieved during evolving survive when the agent is deployed in novel environments or tasks?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2（泛化性）：在演化过程中取得的增益，能否在智能体被部署到全新环境或任务时得以保持？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Mechanisms): How do specific evolutionary operators contribute to the generation and preservation of beneficial modifications?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3（机制）：特定的进化算子如何促进有益修改的生成与保存？

paragraphs.en: We study AHE ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , HyperAgents ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , A-Evolve ( Lin et al., 2026b ) , and GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) with MiniSWE ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) on τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking ( Shi et al., 2026 ) for general tasks and Terminal-Bench 2 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) for coding tasks. Repeated evaluations compare evolved and initial agents in reliability, empirical coverage, regressions, and deployment cost. Split and cross-benchmark comparisons assess generalization, while controlled expansion of existing agents, change interventions, and admission replays trace how gains arise and persist.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 τ^{3}-Banking（Shi et al., 2026）上针对通用任务，并在 Terminal-Bench 2（Merrill et al., 2026）上针对编码任务，结合 MiniSWE（Yang et al., 2024）和 Codex（OpenAI, 2026）研究了 AHE（Lin et al., 2026a）、HyperAgents（Zhang et al., 2026c）、A-Evolve（Lin et al., 2026b）和 GEPA（Agrawal et al., 2026）。 通过重复评估，从可靠性、经验覆盖率、退化和部署成本等方面比较演化后的智能体与初始智能体。 分割基准与跨基准对比用于评估泛化能力，而对现有智能体的受控扩展、变更干预和准入重放则用于追踪收益如何产生并得以保持。

sents.en: We study AHE ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , HyperAgents ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , A-Evolve ( Lin et al., 2026b ) , and GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) with MiniSWE ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and Codex ( OpenAI, 2026 ) on τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking ( Shi et al., 2026 ) for general tasks and Terminal-Bench 2 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) for coding tasks.
sents.zh: 我们在 τ^{3}-Banking（Shi et al., 2026）上针对通用任务，并在 Terminal-Bench 2（Merrill et al., 2026）上针对编码任务，结合 MiniSWE（Yang et al., 2024）和 Codex（OpenAI, 2026）研究了 AHE（Lin et al., 2026a）、HyperAgents（Zhang et al., 2026c）、A-Evolve（Lin et al., 2026b）和 GEPA（Agrawal et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Repeated evaluations compare evolved and initial agents in reliability, empirical coverage, regressions, and deployment cost.
sents.zh: 通过重复评估，从可靠性、经验覆盖率、退化和部署成本等方面比较演化后的智能体与初始智能体。

sents.en: Split and cross-benchmark comparisons assess generalization, while controlled expansion of existing agents, change interventions, and admission replays trace how gains arise and persist.
sents.zh: 分割基准与跨基准对比用于评估泛化能力，而对现有智能体的受控扩展、变更干预和准入重放则用于追踪收益如何产生并得以保持。

paragraphs.en: Harness evolution redistributes task success, with new coverage accompanied by regressions across harnesses, task domains, and evolution paradigms. The practical value of these gains depends on deployment cost and whether they persist beyond the tasks that guided evolution. Specific changes usually outperform generic reminders, yet combining them can alter their value. The strongest existing agent need not offer the greatest further improvement, and stricter admission can discard useful alternatives. Useful improvement therefore requires productive starting points, compatible changes, and search decisions that preserve gains.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架的演化会重新分配任务成功率，在带来新覆盖的同时，也会在不同测试框架、任务领域和演化范式之间引入回退。 这些提升的实际价值取决于部署成本，以及它们能否在引导演化的任务之外持续存在。 具体的改动通常优于泛泛的提醒，但将它们组合起来可能会改变其价值。 现有最强的智能体不一定能带来最大的进一步提升，而更严格的准入机制可能丢弃有用的备选方案。 因此，有效的提升需要有价值的起点、兼容的改动，以及能够保留已有收益的搜索决策。

sents.en: Harness evolution redistributes task success, with new coverage accompanied by regressions across harnesses, task domains, and evolution paradigms.
sents.zh: 测试框架的演化会重新分配任务成功率，在带来新覆盖的同时，也会在不同测试框架、任务领域和演化范式之间引入回退。

sents.zh: 这些提升的实际价值取决于部署成本，以及它们能否在引导演化的任务之外持续存在。

sents.zh: 具体的改动通常优于泛泛的提醒，但将它们组合起来可能会改变其价值。

sents.zh: 现有最强的智能体不一定能带来最大的进一步提升，而更严格的准入机制可能丢弃有用的备选方案。

sents.en: Useful improvement therefore requires productive starting points, compatible changes, and search decisions that preserve gains.
sents.zh: 因此，有效的提升需要有价值的起点、兼容的改动，以及能够保留已有收益的搜索决策。

paragraphs.en: We connect these findings to operator redesign as a constructive follow-up. Analyses of Phenomenology, Generalization, and Mechanisms jointly guide revision hypotheses for select , analyze , mutate , and gate . Each hypothesis specifies its supporting evidence, expected effects, and applicability conditions. We combine these revisions into Audit-Guided Evolution (AGE) to test their practical value.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这些发现与算子重新设计相联系，作为建设性的后续工作。 对现象、泛化与机制的分析共同为 select、analyze、mutate 和 gate 提供修订假设的指导。 每个假设都明确了其支持证据、预期效果和适用条件。 我们将这些修订整合为审计引导进化（AGE），以检验其实际价值。

sents.en: We connect these findings to operator redesign as a constructive follow-up.
sents.zh: 我们将这些发现与算子重新设计相联系，作为建设性的后续工作。

sents.en: We combine these revisions into Audit-Guided Evolution (AGE) to test their practical value.
sents.zh: 我们将这些修订整合为审计引导进化（AGE），以检验其实际价值。

paragraphs.en: Revisiting Practical Improvement. We reveal a gap between benchmark gains and practical utility, showing that useful improvement in agent harness evolution requires preserving useful behavior, managing deployment cost, and sustaining gains beyond the tasks that guide evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 重新审视实用性改进。 我们揭示了基准测试收益与实际效用之间的差距，表明在智能体框架演化中，有用的改进需要保留有用行为、管理部署成本，并在引导演化的任务之外保持收益。

sents.en: Revisiting Practical Improvement.
sents.zh: 重新审视实用性改进。

sents.en: We reveal a gap between benchmark gains and practical utility, showing that useful improvement in agent harness evolution requires preserving useful behavior, managing deployment cost, and sustaining gains beyond the tasks that guide evolution.
sents.zh: 我们揭示了基准测试收益与实际效用之间的差距，表明在智能体框架演化中，有用的改进需要保留有用行为、管理部署成本，并在引导演化的任务之外保持收益。

paragraphs.en: Understanding the Fragility of Gains. We identify productive agent selection, change compatibility, and search retention as central challenges. Current performance can misrepresent further improvement potential, useful changes can interfere, and admission can discard stronger versions.
paragraphs.zh: 理解收益的脆弱性。 我们将生产性智能体选择、变更兼容性和搜索保留确定为核心挑战。 当前性能可能无法真实反映进一步的提升潜力，有用的变更可能相互干扰，而准入机制可能丢弃更强的版本。

sents.en: Understanding the Fragility of Gains.
sents.zh: 理解收益的脆弱性。

sents.en: We identify productive agent selection, change compatibility, and search retention as central challenges.
sents.zh: 我们将生产性智能体选择、变更兼容性和搜索保留确定为核心挑战。

sents.en: Current performance can misrepresent further improvement potential, useful changes can interfere, and admission can discard stronger versions.
sents.zh: 当前性能可能无法真实反映进一步的提升潜力，有用的变更可能相互干扰，而准入机制可能丢弃更强的版本。

paragraphs.en: Improving Evolution Through Analysis. We translate these findings into coordinated revisions of diagnosis, mutation, selection, and admission. The resulting AGE algorithm improves reliability and coverage over its reference method across both benchmarks and harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 通过分析来改进演化。 我们将这些发现转化为对诊断、变异、选择与准入的协同修订。 由此得到的 AGE 算法在两个基准与测试框架上都比其参考方法提升了可靠性与覆盖率。

sents.en: Improving Evolution Through Analysis.
sents.zh: 通过分析来改进演化。

sents.en: We translate these findings into coordinated revisions of diagnosis, mutation, selection, and admission.
sents.zh: 我们将这些发现转化为对诊断、变异、选择与准入的协同修订。

sents.en: The resulting AGE algorithm improves reliability and coverage over its reference method across both benchmarks and harnesses.
sents.zh: 由此得到的 AGE 算法在两个基准与测试框架上都比其参考方法提升了可靠性与覆盖率。

paragraphs.en: Agent Optimization and Evolution. Agent improvement spans inference-time refinement, optimization of persistent artifacts, and open-ended self-modification. Reflexion retains linguistic feedback in episodic memory across trials, whereas Self-Refine iteratively revises the current output ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) . ReflectEvo trains small language models on self-generated reflections to improve introspection and reasoning ( Li et al., 2025 ) . RAM learns from communications to improve an external memory system ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and The AI Hippocampus surveys implicit, explicit, and agentic memory mechanisms ( Jia et al., 2025 ) . DSPy optimizes language-model programs, and TextGrad propagates textual feedback through computational graphs ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Yüksekgönül et al., 2025 ) . Promptbreeder evolves both task and mutation prompts, ACE maintains evolving context playbooks, and CoEvoSkills co-evolves multi-file skill packages with a separate surrogate verifier ( Fernando et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . The four approaches examined here make different choices within this space. AHE exposes editable harness components and uses distilled execution evidence to guide revisions ( Lin et al., 2026a ) . HyperAgents makes both the task agent and its modification procedure editable ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . A-Evolve frames deployment-time adaptation as goal-directed optimization over persistent system state ( Lin et al., 2026b ) . GEPA combines trajectory reflection for prompt updates with Pareto selection of complementary candidates ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体优化与演化。 智能体改进涵盖推理时精炼、持久化制品的优化，以及开放式自我修改。 Reflexion 在多次尝试间于情景记忆中保留语言反馈，而 Self-Refine 则迭代地修订当前输出（Shinn et al., 2023；Madaan et al., 2023）。 ReflectEvo 在自生成的反思上训练小型语言模型，以提升内省与推理能力（Li et al., 2025）。 RAM 通过交流学习来改进外部记忆系统（Li et al., 2024），The AI Hippocampus 则综述了隐式、显式与智能体式记忆机制（Jia et al., 2025）。 DSPy 优化语言模型程序，TextGrad 则在计算图中传播文本反馈（Khattab et al., 2024；Yüksekgönül et al., 2025）。 Promptbreeder 同时演化任务提示与变异提示，ACE 维护不断演化的上下文手册，CoEvoSkills 则让多文件技能包与独立的代理验证器共同演化（Fernando et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2025b；Zhang et al., 2026a）。 本文考察的四种方法在这一空间中做出了不同的选择。 AHE 暴露可编辑的框架组件，并利用蒸馏后的执行证据来引导修订（Lin et al., 2026a）。 HyperAgents 使任务智能体及其修改过程均可编辑（Zhang et al., 2026c）。 A-Evolve 将部署时适配框架化为对持久化系统状态的目标导向优化（Lin et al., 2026b）。 GEPA 将用于提示更新的轨迹反思与互补候选的帕累托选择相结合（Agrawal et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Harness and Program Evolution. Related approaches also optimize system structure and executable code. GPTSwarm optimizes prompt-bearing graph nodes and orchestration edges, while AgentSquare searches combinations of planning, reasoning, tool-use, and memory modules ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Shang et al., 2025 ) . ADAS uses a meta agent to generate agent programs ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . Self-modification extends to the improvement procedure itself: STOP revises optimizer scaffolding, and the Darwin Gödel Machine evolves its own coding agent ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . AlphaEvolve instead evolves target algorithm programs using executable evaluation feedback ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) . Recent work also explores optimizers that construct their own optimization pipelines ( Xue and Yang, 2026 ) . RSIHub composes evolution methods from reusable operators and provides shared evaluation and lineage tracking ( Wang et al., 2026c ) . This distinction between improving task solutions, agent implementations, and optimization procedures motivates separating what changes from how those changes are generated and retained.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架与程序演化。 相关方法同样优化系统结构与可执行代码。 GPTSwarm 优化包含提示词的图节点与编排边，而 AgentSquare 搜索规划、推理、工具使用和记忆模块的组合（Zhuge et al., 2024; Shang et al., 2025）。 ADAS 使用一个元智能体来生成智能体程序（Hu et al., 2025）。 自我修改延伸到改进流程本身：STOP 修改优化器脚手架，达尔文·哥德尔机器则演化自身的编码智能体（Zelikman et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2026b）。 AlphaEvolve 则利用可执行的评估反馈来演化目标算法程序（Novikov et al., 2025）。 近期工作还探索了构建自身优化流程的优化器（Xue and Yang, 2026）。 RSIHub 通过可复用的算子组合演化方法，并提供共享的评估与谱系追踪（Wang et al., 2026c）。 这种在改进任务方案、智能体实现与优化流程之间的区别，促使我们将「改变什么」与「这些改变如何产生和保留」区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Capability Boundaries and Mechanisms. Empirical studies of reasoning distinguish improved small- k k success from expansion of large- k k task coverage ( Yue et al., 2025 ) . Token-level analyses identify concentrated learning signals at high-entropy decisions ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , while studies of on-policy distillation examine behavioral compatibility and information novelty ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Related work also examines the feedback used for improvement. UAPO introduces uncertainty-aware utility anchors for preference optimization ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and SAVE uses value-anchored on-policy feedback to update reward models ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . We apply a related analytical perspective to persistent agent-system changes rather than model-weight updates. Repeated evaluations distinguish reliability from empirical coverage, common-process Parent expansion tests improvement potential, Component interventions examine change compatibility, and frozen-pool admission replays assess retention.
paragraphs.zh: 能力边界与机制。 关于推理的实证研究区分了小 k k 情形下成功率的提升与大 k k 情形下任务覆盖面的扩展 ( Yue et al., 2025 ) 。 词元级分析发现学习信号集中于高熵决策点 ( Wang et al., 2025a ) ，而关于策略内蒸馏的研究则考察行为兼容性与信息新颖性 ( Li et al., 2026 ) 。 相关工作还考察了用于改进的反馈。 UAPO 为偏好优化引入了不确定性感知的效用锚点 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) ，SAVE 则使用价值锚定的策略内反馈来更新奖励模型 ( Wang et al., 2026a ) 。 我们将一种相关的分析视角应用于持久性的智能体系统变更，而非模型权重更新。 重复评估区分可靠性与实证覆盖，共同父节点的 Parent 扩展检验改进潜力，Component 干预考察变更兼容性，而冻结池的准入重放评估保留能力。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of Agent Systems. Agent evaluation must account for cost, reproducibility, and generalization beyond aggregate success ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ) . For harness evolution specifically, Wang et al. (2026b) find inconsistent advantages over test-time scaling under comparable feedback and inference budgets, together with limited held-out generalization. Performance also depends on interactions among the model, harness, task structure, and coordination overhead ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . The τ \tau -bench family emphasizes reliable tool-agent-user interaction, while Terminal-Bench 2 evaluates long-horizon execution in terminal environments ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . We study general and coding tasks through these complementary settings, distinguish task exposure during evolution, and assess external transfer without further agent revision. These comparisons connect measured improvement to its deployment cost and scope of applicability.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统的评估。 智能体评估必须考虑成本、可复现性以及在总体成功率之外泛化的问题（Kapoor et al., 2025）。 具体到测试框架演化，Wang et al. （2026b）发现在可比较的反馈和推理预算下，相比测试时扩展并无一致优势，且在留出集上的泛化有限。 性能还取决于模型、测试框架、任务结构与协调开销之间的交互（Kim et al., 2025）。 τ \tau -bench 系列强调可靠的工具—智能体—用户交互，而 Terminal-Bench 2 评估终端环境中的长时程执行（Yao et al., 2025; Merrill et al., 2026）。 我们通过这些互补的设置研究通用任务与编程任务，区分演化过程中的任务暴露情况，并在不进一步修改智能体的情况下评估外部迁移。 这些比较将测得的改进与其部署成本及适用范围联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Methods and Harnesses. We evaluate AHE ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , HyperAgents ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , A-Evolve ( Lin et al., 2026b ) , and GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) using GPT-5.4 . AHE and HyperAgents are implementation-centric recipes that emphasize agent engineering, whereas A-Evolve and GEPA are reflection-centric recipes that distill execution feedback into reusable changes. We run each recipe with two harnesses. MiniSWE 2.4.5 ( Yang et al., 2024 ) is source-editable and permits inner-source changes. Codex 0.143.0 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) is outer-layer-only and permits changes to prompts, skills, configuration, and external orchestration. These combinations let us examine different evolution designs under a common process. Appendix A details their implementations.

paragraphs.en: In this common process, each recipe specifies how seven operators are implemented: select chooses a Parent, rollout collects execution evidence, analyze diagnoses it, and mutate proposes a Candidate. The validate operator optionally checks the proposal, gate decides admission, and record archives outcomes. We focus the mechanism analysis on select , analyze , mutate , and gate because their decisions determine which Parents are used, how evidence guides changes, and which Candidates persist.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一通用流程中，每个配方规定七个算子如何实现：select 选择一个 Parent，rollout 收集执行证据，analyze 对其进行诊断，mutate 提出一个 Candidate。 validate 算子可选地检查提案，gate 决定是否准入，record 归档结果。 我们将机制分析聚焦于 select、analyze、mutate 和 gate，因为它们的决策决定了使用哪些 Parent、证据如何指导变更，以及哪些 Candidate 得以留存。

paragraphs.en: Behavioral Changes Behind Task-Level Gains and Losses. We inspect contrasting traces for tasks with large success-count changes. Across the sampled harnesses, domains, and paradigms, recurring differences concern state preservation, precise grounding, and task completion. Successful traces preserve recovery files and respect action dependencies, while failures include incorrect arguments, premature termination, and solutions that work locally but fail in the required environment. These contrasts motivate preservation and end-to-end checks rather than equating every outcome flip with acquired or lost task knowledge. Table 2 summarizes the categories; Appendix B.3 gives case evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 任务层面的收益与损失背后的行为变化。 我们检查成功次数变化较大的任务的对比轨迹。 在所抽样的测试框架、领域和范式中，反复出现的差异涉及状态保持、精确接地以及任务完成。 成功的轨迹会保留恢复文件并遵循动作依赖关系，而失败的轨迹则包含错误的参数、过早终止，以及只在本地有效却在所需环境中失败的解决方案。 这些对比促使我们采用保持性与端到端检查，而不是把每一次结果的翻转都等同于获得或丧失了任务知识。 表 2 总结了这些类别；附录 B.3 提供了案例证据。

paragraphs.en: Per-Trial Cost and Deployment Efficiency Can Diverge. Eight of eleven reliability-improving Champions cost more per trial than Seed; the three lower-cost gains use the source-editable harness on coding tasks. Yet Figure 3 shows that higher per-trial cost can coexist with fewer attempts and lower cost to reach comparable coverage. MiniSWE with AHE on τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking reaches 56.7% coverage in four passes, exceeding Seed’s 54.6% in eight at lower deployment cost. Practical efficiency therefore depends on both cost per attempt and the attempts needed to attain a given coverage level.
paragraphs.zh: 单次试验成本与部署效率可能出现分化。 十一个提升可靠性的冠军方法中有八个的单次试验成本高于 Seed；三个成本更低的收益来自在编码任务上使用可编辑源码的测试框架。 然而，图 3 显示更高的单次试验成本可以与更少的尝试次数和更低的成本并存，同时达到相当的覆盖率。 在 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking 上使用 AHE 的 MiniSWE 在四次通过中达到 56.7% 的覆盖率，以更低的部署成本超过了 Seed 八次通过取得的 54.6%。 因此，实际效率同时取决于单次尝试的成本以及达到给定覆盖率所需的尝试次数。

sents.en: Per-Trial Cost and Deployment Efficiency Can Diverge.
sents.zh: 单次试验成本与部署效率可能出现分化。

sents.zh: 然而，图 3 显示更高的单次试验成本可以与更少的尝试次数和更低的成本并存，同时达到相当的覆盖率。

sents.en: MiniSWE with AHE on τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking reaches 56.7% coverage in four passes, exceeding Seed’s 54.6% in eight at lower deployment cost.
sents.zh: 在 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking 上使用 AHE 的 MiniSWE 在四次通过中达到 56.7% 的覆盖率，以更低的部署成本超过了 Seed 八次通过取得的 54.6%。

sents.en: Practical efficiency therefore depends on both cost per attempt and the attempts needed to attain a given coverage level.
sents.zh: 因此，实际效率同时取决于单次尝试的成本以及达到给定覆盖率所需的尝试次数。

paragraphs.en: Gains Often Survive Beyond Direct Feedback. Test reliability improves in ten of sixteen lineages, including seven of eight implementation-centric cases across both harness types and task domains. Reflection-centric gains are more harness-dependent: most source-editable cases improve, whereas all outer-layer-only cases decline. Improvement therefore frequently reaches feedback-excluded tasks, with systematic differences across harness–paradigm combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 收益往往能在直接反馈之外得以保留。 测试可靠性在十六个谱系中的十个得到提升，包括八种以实现为中心的案例中的七种，覆盖两种测试框架类型和任务领域。 以反思为中心的收益更依赖测试框架：大多数可编辑源代码的案例有所提升，而所有仅限外层的案例则有所下降。 因此，提升经常能延伸到排除反馈的任务，且在不同测试框架与范式的组合之间存在系统性差异。

paragraphs.en: Transfer Selectively Preserves Gains. Coverage falls for seven of eight Champions on the general-task target but rises for seven of eight on the coding target, spanning both harness types and paradigms. Reliability can move in the opposite direction. All source-editable Champions improve general-task transfer reliability but lose coding-task transfer reliability, despite coverage gains in three coding cases. Transfer therefore changes the balance between reliability and coverage, so the persistence of improvement must be assessed separately for each outcome and target.
paragraphs.zh: 迁移选择性地保留收益。 在通用任务目标上，八个冠军模型中有七个的覆盖率下降，但在编程目标上，八个中有七个的覆盖率上升，这一现象跨越了两种测试框架类型和范式。 可靠性可能朝相反方向变化。 所有可编辑源码的冠军模型都提升了通用任务的迁移可靠性，却损失了编程任务的迁移可靠性，尽管其中三个编程案例的覆盖率有所提升。 因此，迁移改变了可靠性与覆盖率之间的平衡，所以必须针对每种结果和每个目标分别评估改进的持续性。

paragraphs.en: Current Scores Do Not Consistently Identify Improvement Potential. Original falls below the 25% random baseline on general tasks but exceeds 55% on coding tasks, across both harnesses. This reversal shows that selection signals align with further improvement differently across domains. Evaluating select therefore requires measuring subsequent gains alongside current performance.

paragraphs.en: Mutation Quality Depends on How Changes Combine. Six of eight Champions outperform either isolated Component in reliability, including all coding-task cases (Table 5 ). Two general-task cases, one per harness, favor a subset. In one coding case, only the combination improves over Seed. These patterns motivate mutate to preserve dependencies and check harmful interactions and useful complementarities in the complete Candidate. Appendix D.3 reports interaction estimates.

paragraphs.en: Admission Constraints Have Harness-Dependent Effects. Constrained admission reduces best-Candidate retention from fifteen to six pools. Yet its size-normalized score falls for the source-editable harness and rises for the outer-layer-only harness on both domains (Table 7 ). The increase reflects smaller sets retaining a best Seed alone. Admission quality therefore requires inspecting preservation, set size, and Candidate identity together. Appendix D.4 gives per-pool results.

paragraphs.en: We propose EvoAudit , an agent-assisted workflow that runs diagnostics on archived artifacts and returns operator revisions with evidence and validation records (Figure 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 EvoAudit，一种由智能体辅助的工作流，可对存档工件运行诊断，并返回附带证据与验证记录的操作员修订版（图 4）。

paragraphs.en: Installing its four revisions in A-Evolve gives Audit-Guided Evolution (AGE). Other operators, model and evaluator contracts, and harness editing constraints remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 将其四个修订版安装到 A-Evolve 中即得到审计引导演化（AGE）。 其他算子、模型与评估器契约，以及测试框架编辑约束保持不变。

sents.en: Other operators, model and evaluator contracts, and harness editing constraints remain fixed.
sents.zh: 其他算子、模型与评估器契约，以及测试框架编辑约束保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Recipe and Evidence Flow. AGE installs four fixed operator revisions in the A-Evolve recipe described in Appendix A , shared across both benchmarks and harnesses. Each generation selects a Parent, collects fresh Train trajectories, diagnoses behavior, and proposes one Candidate. Framework scope checks and canonical Validation evaluation precede admission and recording. The reference rollout and record implementations are unchanged, and the optional validate stage is disabled. MiniSWE permits changes to inner source and outer artifacts, whereas Codex permits only outer-artifact changes. The evaluator, task partitions, model settings, resource limits, and evolution operators remain fixed. Online decisions use Train and Validation evidence.

paragraphs.en: Analyze: Behavior-Grounded Diagnosis. The analyzer collects the current rollout and, when available, one preceding rollout along the selected lineage, retaining the last 30 records in their stored order. Each judge input contains chronological tool calls, successful and failed tool results, and the completion signal. Tool arguments and results are capped at 600 and 800 characters, respectively. Each rendered trajectory uses at most 12,000 characters, preserving approximately two-thirds from its beginning and one-third from its end when truncated. Interrupted executions can include a bounded termination message. The behavior bundle excludes benchmark rewards, verifier outputs, hidden tests, raw task text, and raw-case paths.
paragraphs.zh: 分析：基于行为的诊断。 分析器收集当前执行轨迹，并在可用时收集所选脉络上之前的一次执行轨迹，按存储顺序保留最近 30 条记录。 每个评判输入包含按时间顺序排列的工具调用、成功和失败的工具结果，以及完成信号。 工具参数和结果分别限制在 600 和 800 个字符以内。 每条渲染的轨迹最多使用 12,000 个字符，截断时大约保留开头三分之二和结尾三分之一。 被中断的执行可以包含一条有长度限制的终止消息。 行为包不包含基准测试奖励、验证器输出、隐藏测试、原始任务文本和原始用例路径。

paragraphs.en: The judge returns score , category , outcome , and failure_reason . Scores 0–3 indicate visible breakdown, 4–6 indicate partial or ambiguous progress, and 7–10 indicate visible completion supported by an appropriate check or comparably decisive result. Verdicts distinguish Observed: behavior from Inference: explanations and ground completion judgments in trajectory evidence. These behavioral scores guide diagnosis, while benchmark scores drive select and gate . Each request permits one attempt with a 600-second timeout. Invalid or failed responses return an unknown verdict with sentinel score − 1 -1 .
paragraphs.zh: 裁判返回 score、category、outcome 和 failure_reason。 分数 0–3 表示可见的失效，4–6 表示部分或模糊的进展，7–10 表示由适当检查或同等决定性结果支持的可见完成。 判定区分 Observed: 行为、Inference: 解释以及轨迹证据中的最终完成判断。 这些行为分数用于指导诊断，而基准分数则驱动 select 和 gate。 每个请求仅允许一次尝试，超时时间为 600 秒。 无效或失败的响应会返回 unknown 判定，并带有哨兵分数 −1 -1。

paragraphs.en: Mutate: Mechanism-Linked, Dependency-Closed Changes. The mutation agent receives the selected behavior evidence, Parent workspace, prompt and skill inventory, and editing contract. Before choosing files, its instructions require the observed behavior, inferred mechanism, replacement behavior, activation conditions, and expected trade-off. A recurring concrete pattern or a single severe, visibly supported breakdown can motivate a change, while ambiguous evidence favors preserving current behavior. The agent must inspect affected interfaces and their producers and consumers, make one coherent intervention, preserve useful behavior in successful traces, and check for conflicting or duplicated guidance. Dependency-closed changes may span multiple files and layers.
paragraphs.zh: 变异：与机制关联、依赖闭合的变更。 变异智能体接收选定的行为证据、父工作区、提示词和技能清单，以及编辑契约。 在选择文件之前，其指令要求明确观察到的行为、推断的机制、替换行为、激活条件和预期权衡。 反复出现的具体模式，或单一严重且有明显依据的故障，都可以推动一次变更；而模糊的证据则倾向于保留当前行为。 智能体必须检查受影响的接口及其生产者和消费者，进行一次连贯的干预，保留成功轨迹中的有用行为，并检查是否存在冲突或重复的指导。 依赖闭合的变更可能跨越多个文件和多个层次。

Outputs retain the patch, changed-file list, surface-check report, agent response, and usage record. Structural checks enforce editing surfaces and interfaces, while the mutation instructions specify evidence grounding, dependency closure, and behavior preservation. Execution errors stop the operator and are recorded with their diagnostic information.

paragraphs.en: Here c c is the recorded USD cost of canonical Validation evaluation. The comparability predicate Q Q requires matching task-set hashes, finite strictly positive costs, and a direct Parent evaluation. Equal-score admission requires a verified, comparable cost reduction. When cost comparability fails, only the score-improvement branch applies. A valid matched Parent and finite scores are required, and all other Candidates are rejected. The operator reuses canonical evaluations and preserves score improvement as its primary objective.
paragraphs.zh: 这里 c c 是记录的规范验证评估的美元成本。 可比性谓词 Q Q 要求匹配任务集哈希、有限且严格为正的成本，以及直接的父代评估。 等分准入要求经验证的可比成本降低。 当成本可比性失败时，仅适用分数提升分支。 要求存在有效的匹配父代和有限的分数，且所有其他候选均被拒绝。 该算子复用规范评估，并将分数提升保持为其首要目标。

sents.en: Here c c is the recorded USD cost of canonical Validation evaluation.
sents.zh: 这里 c c 是记录的规范验证评估的美元成本。

sents.en: The comparability predicate Q Q requires matching task-set hashes, finite strictly positive costs, and a direct Parent evaluation.
sents.zh: 可比性谓词 Q Q 要求匹配任务集哈希、有限且严格为正的成本，以及直接的父代评估。

sents.en: Equal-score admission requires a verified, comparable cost reduction.
sents.zh: 等分准入要求经验证的可比成本降低。

sents.en: When cost comparability fails, only the score-improvement branch applies.
sents.zh: 当成本可比性失败时，仅适用分数提升分支。

sents.en: A valid matched Parent and finite scores are required, and all other Candidates are rejected.
sents.zh: 要求存在有效的匹配父代和有限的分数，且所有其他候选均被拒绝。

sents.en: The operator reuses canonical evaluations and preserves score improvement as its primary objective.
sents.zh: 该算子复用规范评估，并将分数提升保持为其首要目标。

paragraphs.en: Eight experts reviewed all four operator revisions. Each chose a direction before seeing the proposal, then judged its evidence, whether it addressed the stated problem, and whether it should enter validation. Table 9 reports the mean number of experts per revision. Overall, expert judgments broadly align with EvoAudit’s proposed directions and support validating the resulting revisions. Appendix E.2 details the protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 八位专家评审了全部四个算子修订版本。 每位专家在查看提案之前先选择一个方向，然后评估其证据、是否解决了所述问题，以及是否应进入验证阶段。 表 9 报告了每个修订版本的平均专家人数。 总体而言，专家的判断与 EvoAudit 提出的方向基本一致，并支持对 resulting 修订版本进行验证。 附录 E.2 详细说明了该协议。

sents.en: Eight experts reviewed all four operator revisions.
sents.zh: 八位专家评审了全部四个算子修订版本。

sents.en: Each chose a direction before seeing the proposal, then judged its evidence, whether it addressed the stated problem, and whether it should enter validation.
sents.zh: 每位专家在查看提案之前先选择一个方向，然后评估其证据、是否解决了所述问题，以及是否应进入验证阶段。

sents.en: Table 9 reports the mean number of experts per revision.
sents.zh: 表 9 报告了每个修订版本的平均专家人数。

sents.en: Overall, expert judgments broadly align with EvoAudit’s proposed directions and support validating the resulting revisions.
sents.zh: 总体而言，专家的判断与 EvoAudit 提出的方向基本一致，并支持对 resulting 修订版本进行验证。

sents.en: Appendix E.2 details the protocol.
sents.zh: 附录 E.2 详细说明了该协议。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 compares AGE with the four methods across both benchmarks and harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 表 10 在两个基准测试和测试框架上对 AGE 与这四种方法进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Combined Revisions Improve Outcomes Across Settings. AGE improves reliability and coverage over A-Evolve in all four settings and loses fewer Seed-covered tasks in three, tying in the fourth. This consistency across domains and harnesses supports the practical value of evidence-guided revision.
paragraphs.zh: 组合修订在各种场景下均能改善结果。 AGE 在所有四个场景中都比 A-Evolve 提高了可靠性和覆盖率，并在其中三个场景中损失的种子覆盖任务更少，在第四个场景中打平。 这种跨领域和跨评测框架的一致性支持了证据引导修订的实用价值。

sents.en: Combined Revisions Improve Outcomes Across Settings.
sents.zh: 组合修订在各种场景下均能改善结果。

sents.en: AGE improves reliability and coverage over A-Evolve in all four settings and loses fewer Seed-covered tasks in three, tying in the fourth.
sents.zh: AGE 在所有四个场景中都比 A-Evolve 提高了可靠性和覆盖率，并在其中三个场景中损失的种子覆盖任务更少，在第四个场景中打平。

sents.en: This consistency across domains and harnesses supports the practical value of evidence-guided revision.
sents.zh: 这种跨领域和跨评测框架的一致性支持了证据引导修订的实用价值。

paragraphs.en: Feedback Can Be Narrower Than a Change’s Effects. Harness changes affect many behaviors, while evaluation samples finite executions and compresses their trade-offs. A prompt, skill, or execution routine can help the tasks that supply feedback while disrupting behavior elsewhere. This mismatch offers a common explanation for task regressions, context-dependent change interactions, and selective transfer. It suggests that practical evolution depends on how well feedback represents the consequences of a change, including the resources needed to deploy it.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈可以比一个变更的效果更窄。 改装（harness）变更会影响许多行为，而评估只采样有限的执行，并将这些执行的权衡压缩成一个结果。 一条提示词、一项技能或一个执行例程可以帮助提供反馈的那些任务，同时干扰其他地方的行为。 这种不匹配为任务退化、依赖上下文的变更交互以及选择性迁移提供了一个常见的解释。 它表明，实际的演化取决于反馈能在多大程度上代表一个变更的后果，包括部署该变更所需的资源。

sents.en: Feedback Can Be Narrower Than a Change’s Effects.
sents.zh: 反馈可以比一个变更的效果更窄。

sents.en: Harness changes affect many behaviors, while evaluation samples finite executions and compresses their trade-offs.
sents.zh: 改装（harness）变更会影响许多行为，而评估只采样有限的执行，并将这些执行的权衡压缩成一个结果。

sents.en: A prompt, skill, or execution routine can help the tasks that supply feedback while disrupting behavior elsewhere.
sents.zh: 一条提示词、一项技能或一个执行例程可以帮助提供反馈的那些任务，同时干扰其他地方的行为。

sents.en: This mismatch offers a common explanation for task regressions, context-dependent change interactions, and selective transfer.
sents.zh: 这种不匹配为任务退化、依赖上下文的变更交互以及选择性迁移提供了一个常见的解释。

sents.en: It suggests that practical evolution depends on how well feedback represents the consequences of a change, including the resources needed to deploy it.
sents.zh: 它表明，实际的演化取决于反馈能在多大程度上代表一个变更的后果，包括部署该变更所需的资源。

paragraphs.en: Evidence Must Match the Decision. Current performance, improvement potential, change compatibility, and retention are distinct objectives. A high-scoring Parent need not yield the greatest subsequent gain, a useful Component can interfere with other changes, and a conservative gate can discard alternatives. Together, the diagnostics show why evidence supporting one decision need not support the next. Evaluation should test the desired consequence of each decision, rather than reuse the same aggregate score throughout evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 证据必须与决策相匹配。 当前性能、改进潜力、变更兼容性与保留是不同的目标。 高分的父代不一定带来最大的后续增益，一个有用的组件可能与其他变更相互干扰，而一个保守的门控可能丢弃备选方案。 综合来看，这些诊断结果表明，支持某一决策的证据未必支持下一个决策。 评估应当检验每个决策所期望的结果，而不是在整个进化过程中重复使用同一个聚合分数。

sents.en: Evidence Must Match the Decision.
sents.zh: 证据必须与决策相匹配。

sents.en: Current performance, improvement potential, change compatibility, and retention are distinct objectives.
sents.zh: 当前性能、改进潜力、变更兼容性与保留是不同的目标。

sents.en: A high-scoring Parent need not yield the greatest subsequent gain, a useful Component can interfere with other changes, and a conservative gate can discard alternatives.
sents.zh: 高分的父代不一定带来最大的后续增益，一个有用的组件可能与其他变更相互干扰，而一个保守的门控可能丢弃备选方案。

sents.en: Together, the diagnostics show why evidence supporting one decision need not support the next.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些诊断结果表明，支持某一决策的证据未必支持下一个决策。

sents.en: Evaluation should test the desired consequence of each decision, rather than reuse the same aggregate score throughout evolution.
sents.zh: 评估应当检验每个决策所期望的结果，而不是在整个进化过程中重复使用同一个聚合分数。

paragraphs.en: Toward Decision-Specific Feedback. Evaluate select through subsequent gains, ground analyze and mutate in traces and dependencies, and assess gate through both retained quality and preserved alternatives. Deployment cost and external evaluation then determine how broadly these benefits remain useful. EvoAudit and AGE illustrate how these complementary checks can guide a coordinated redesign while preserving the reference method’s execution and evaluation contracts.
paragraphs.zh: 迈向针对特定决策的反馈。 通过后续增益来评估 select，基于轨迹和依赖关系来夯实 analyze 与 mutate，并通过保留的质量与保留下来的备选方案两方面来评估 gate。 部署成本与外部评估随后将决定这些收益能在多大范围内保持有用。 EvoAudit 与 AGE 展示了这些互补检查如何在保留参考方法的执行与评估契约的同时，指导一次协调一致的重新设计。

sents.en: Toward Decision-Specific Feedback.
sents.zh: 迈向针对特定决策的反馈。

sents.en: Evaluate select through subsequent gains, ground analyze and mutate in traces and dependencies, and assess gate through both retained quality and preserved alternatives.
sents.zh: 通过后续增益来评估 select，基于轨迹和依赖关系来夯实 analyze 与 mutate，并通过保留的质量与保留下来的备选方案两方面来评估 gate。

sents.en: Deployment cost and external evaluation then determine how broadly these benefits remain useful.
sents.zh: 部署成本与外部评估随后将决定这些收益能在多大范围内保持有用。

sents.en: EvoAudit and AGE illustrate how these complementary checks can guide a coordinated redesign while preserving the reference method’s execution and evaluation contracts.
sents.zh: EvoAudit 与 AGE 展示了这些互补检查如何在保留参考方法的执行与评估契约的同时，指导一次协调一致的重新设计。

paragraphs.en: Our study shows that harness evolution redistributes observed task success, bringing both gains and regressions. Across harnesses, task domains, and evolution paradigms, practical improvement depends on productive Parents, compatible changes, preservation through search, and generalization at affordable cost. EvoAudit connects these findings to operator revisions, and AGE improves reliability and coverage over its reference method in all four settings. These results motivate evaluating evolution by the useful behavior it creates and sustains, beyond final benchmark scores.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究表明，测试框架的演化会重新分配观察到的任务成功，既带来提升也带来退化。 跨越测试框架、任务领域和演化范式，实际的改进取决于富有成效的父代、兼容的变更、通过搜索实现的保留，以及以可承受代价实现的泛化。 EvoAudit 将这些发现与算子修订相联系，而 AGE 在全部四种设置中都相比其参考方法提升了可靠性和覆盖面。 这些结果促使我们以演化所创造并维持的有效行为来评估演化，而不仅看最终的基准测试分数。

sents.en: Our study shows that harness evolution redistributes observed task success, bringing both gains and regressions.
sents.zh: 我们的研究表明，测试框架的演化会重新分配观察到的任务成功，既带来提升也带来退化。

sents.en: Across harnesses, task domains, and evolution paradigms, practical improvement depends on productive Parents, compatible changes, preservation through search, and generalization at affordable cost.
sents.zh: 跨越测试框架、任务领域和演化范式，实际的改进取决于富有成效的父代、兼容的变更、通过搜索实现的保留，以及以可承受代价实现的泛化。

sents.en: EvoAudit connects these findings to operator revisions, and AGE improves reliability and coverage over its reference method in all four settings.
sents.zh: EvoAudit 将这些发现与算子修订相联系，而 AGE 在全部四种设置中都相比其参考方法提升了可靠性和覆盖面。

sents.en: These results motivate evaluating evolution by the useful behavior it creates and sustains, beyond final benchmark scores.
sents.zh: 这些结果促使我们以演化所创造并维持的有效行为来评估演化，而不仅看最终的基准测试分数。

paragraphs.en: Experiments run in isolated benchmark environments rather than live user-facing services. Evolving agent instructions and code can introduce regressions and unintended tool use. We retain fixed evaluation contracts and harness-specific editing permissions, and examine regressions and transfer alongside aggregate performance. Participants in the human evaluation provided informed consent. The expert-review protocol evaluates the evidence, reasoning, and proposed approaches for operator revisions, as described in Appendix E.2 . Neither benchmark gains nor expert endorsement establishes safety for deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 实验在隔离的基准测试环境中运行，而非面向用户的在线服务。 对智能体指令和代码的演进可能引入回归和意外的工具使用。 我们保留固定的评估契约和特定于评测框架的编辑权限，并在考察总体性能的同时检视回归与迁移情况。 参与人类评估的受试者均提供了知情同意。 专家评审协议如附录 E.2 所述，评估算子修订的证据、推理和所提出的方法。 基准测试的提升和专家的认可均不能证明部署的安全性。

sents.en: Experiments run in isolated benchmark environments rather than live user-facing services.
sents.zh: 实验在隔离的基准测试环境中运行，而非面向用户的在线服务。

sents.en: Evolving agent instructions and code can introduce regressions and unintended tool use.
sents.zh: 对智能体指令和代码的演进可能引入回归和意外的工具使用。

sents.en: We retain fixed evaluation contracts and harness-specific editing permissions, and examine regressions and transfer alongside aggregate performance.
sents.zh: 我们保留固定的评估契约和特定于评测框架的编辑权限，并在考察总体性能的同时检视回归与迁移情况。

sents.en: Participants in the human evaluation provided informed consent.
sents.zh: 参与人类评估的受试者均提供了知情同意。

sents.en: The expert-review protocol evaluates the evidence, reasoning, and proposed approaches for operator revisions, as described in Appendix E.2 .
sents.zh: 专家评审协议如附录 E.2 所述，评估算子修订的证据、推理和所提出的方法。

sents.en: Neither benchmark gains nor expert endorsement establishes safety for deployment.
sents.zh: 基准测试的提升和专家的认可均不能证明部署的安全性。

paragraphs.en: We describe the implementations used in our experiments through the seven operator stages in Table 11 . All four methods share fixed target-model and evaluator contracts. MiniSWE permits dependency-closed changes to inner source code as well as prompts, skills, configuration, and orchestration; Codex permits only changes outside its immutable executable and source. HyperAgents additionally permits changes to designated evolution operators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过表 11 中的七个算子阶段来描述实验中所使用的实现。 全部四种方法共享固定的目标模型与评估器契约。 MiniSWE 允许对内部源代码进行依赖封闭式的修改，也允许修改提示词、技能、配置和编排；Codex 只允许修改其不可变可执行文件和源代码之外的内容。 HyperAgents 还允许对指定的进化算子进行修改。

sents.en: We describe the implementations used in our experiments through the seven operator stages in Table 11 .
sents.zh: 我们通过表 11 中的七个算子阶段来描述实验中所使用的实现。

sents.en: All four methods share fixed target-model and evaluator contracts.
sents.zh: 全部四种方法共享固定的目标模型与评估器契约。

sents.en: MiniSWE permits dependency-closed changes to inner source code as well as prompts, skills, configuration, and orchestration; Codex permits only changes outside its immutable executable and source.
sents.zh: MiniSWE 允许对内部源代码进行依赖封闭式的修改，也允许修改提示词、技能、配置和编排；Codex 只允许修改其不可变可执行文件和源代码之外的内容。

sents.en: HyperAgents additionally permits changes to designated evolution operators.
sents.zh: HyperAgents 还允许对指定的进化算子进行修改。

paragraphs.en: Evolution Paradigms. Our design-based grouping distinguishes implementation-centric recipes, AHE and HyperAgents, from reflection-centric recipes, A-Evolve and GEPA. The former organize revision around engineering the agent implementation or improvement machinery; the latter organize it around distilling execution experience and feedback. Both use evidence and may modify code within the harness’s legal surface. The grouping follows recipe design, while the harness determines the permitted editing surface. Codex permits changes to external orchestration code while keeping its executable and inner source immutable.
paragraphs.zh: 演化范式。 我们基于设计的分组将侧重实现的配方（AHE 和 HyperAgents）与侧重反思的配方（A-Evolve 和 GEPA）区分开来。 前者围绕对智能体实现或改进机制的工程化来组织修订；后者围绕提炼执行经验与反馈来组织修订。 两者都使用证据，并且都可以在 harness 的合法范围内修改代码。 分组依据的是配方的设计，而 harness 则决定允许编辑的范围。 Codex 允许修改外部编排代码，同时保持其可执行文件和内部源代码不可更改。

sents.en: Evolution Paradigms.
sents.zh: 演化范式。

sents.en: Our design-based grouping distinguishes implementation-centric recipes, AHE and HyperAgents, from reflection-centric recipes, A-Evolve and GEPA.
sents.zh: 我们基于设计的分组将侧重实现的配方（AHE 和 HyperAgents）与侧重反思的配方（A-Evolve 和 GEPA）区分开来。

sents.en: The former organize revision around engineering the agent implementation or improvement machinery; the latter organize it around distilling execution experience and feedback.
sents.zh: 前者围绕对智能体实现或改进机制的工程化来组织修订；后者围绕提炼执行经验与反馈来组织修订。

sents.en: Both use evidence and may modify code within the harness’s legal surface.
sents.zh: 两者都使用证据，并且都可以在 harness 的合法范围内修改代码。

sents.en: The grouping follows recipe design, while the harness determines the permitted editing surface.
sents.zh: 分组依据的是配方的设计，而 harness 则决定允许编辑的范围。

sents.en: Codex permits changes to external orchestration code while keeping its executable and inner source immutable.
sents.zh: Codex 允许修改外部编排代码，同时保持其可执行文件和内部源代码不可更改。

paragraphs.en: Search scores use Train tasks for AHE and HyperAgents, and Validation tasks for A-Evolve and GEPA. The validate operator checks proposals, while the Validation split supplies evaluation tasks. Shared scope and evaluation-eligibility checks apply to all four methods, including those that omit the optional validate stage. Test outcomes remain excluded from search.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索评分对 AHE 和 HyperAgents 使用训练任务，对 A-Evolve 和 GEPA 使用验证任务。 验证（validate）算子负责检查提案，而验证集（Validation split）则提供评估任务。 共享范围与评估资格检查适用于所有四种方法，包括那些省略可选验证（validate）阶段的方法。 测试结果始终不被纳入搜索过程。

sents.en: Search scores use Train tasks for AHE and HyperAgents, and Validation tasks for A-Evolve and GEPA.
sents.zh: 搜索评分对 AHE 和 HyperAgents 使用训练任务，对 A-Evolve 和 GEPA 使用验证任务。

sents.en: The validate operator checks proposals, while the Validation split supplies evaluation tasks.
sents.zh: 验证（validate）算子负责检查提案，而验证集（Validation split）则提供评估任务。

sents.en: Shared scope and evaluation-eligibility checks apply to all four methods, including those that omit the optional validate stage.
sents.zh: 共享范围与评估资格检查适用于所有四种方法，包括那些省略可选验证（validate）阶段的方法。

sents.en: Test outcomes remain excluded from search.
sents.zh: 测试结果始终不被纳入搜索过程。

paragraphs.en: Selection and Diagnosis. AHE emphasizes observability-grounded revision ( Lin et al., 2026a ) . Its select operator chooses the newest eligible Parent, not necessarily the highest-scoring one. The rollout operator reuses that Parent’s evaluation traces. The analyze operator produces task-level debugger reports: failure reports identify the failure point, possible cause, and corrective lesson, while successful traces expose reusable strategies and fragile behavior. Mixed outcomes on a task can therefore inform the diagnosis alongside outright failures. An overview links these reports to prior changes and their observed effects.
paragraphs.zh: 选择与诊断。 AHE 强调基于可观测性的修订（ Lin et al., 2026a ）。 其选择算子选取最新的符合条件的父代，而不一定是得分最高的那个。 回放算子复用该父代的评估轨迹。 分析算子生成任务级的调试报告：失败报告指出失败点、可能原因和纠正性经验，而成功轨迹则揭示可复用的策略与脆弱的行为。 因此，同一任务上的混合结果可以与彻底失败一起为诊断提供依据。 概览将这些报告与先前的更改及其观察到的效果关联起来。

sents.en: Selection and Diagnosis.
sents.zh: 选择与诊断。

sents.en: AHE emphasizes observability-grounded revision ( Lin et al., 2026a ) .
sents.zh: AHE 强调基于可观测性的修订（ Lin et al., 2026a ）。

sents.en: Its select operator chooses the newest eligible Parent, not necessarily the highest-scoring one.
sents.zh: 其选择算子选取最新的符合条件的父代，而不一定是得分最高的那个。

sents.en: The rollout operator reuses that Parent’s evaluation traces.
sents.zh: 回放算子复用该父代的评估轨迹。

sents.en: The analyze operator produces task-level debugger reports: failure reports identify the failure point, possible cause, and corrective lesson, while successful traces expose reusable strategies and fragile behavior.
sents.zh: 分析算子生成任务级的调试报告：失败报告指出失败点、可能原因和纠正性经验，而成功轨迹则揭示可复用的策略与脆弱的行为。

sents.en: Mixed outcomes on a task can therefore inform the diagnosis alongside outright failures.
sents.zh: 因此，同一任务上的混合结果可以与彻底失败一起为诊断提供依据。

sents.en: An overview links these reports to prior changes and their observed effects.
sents.zh: 概览将这些报告与先前的更改及其观察到的效果关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Revision and Admission. The mutation agent is instructed to make one coherent, testable change, supported by task evidence and an identified execution path. It considers whether to retain, revise, or roll back the preceding change and pursue a different explanation. A change manifest records the proposed mechanism, affected files, predicted fixes, and behaviors at risk. Debugger reports supply hypotheses for revision. There is no separate optional validate stage. The gate operator admits a completed, eligible evaluation without requiring a higher score, so the next Parent can come from a lower-scoring revision. The record operator preserves outcomes and change evidence. Admission and continuation are thus distinct from final Champion reporting.
paragraphs.zh: 修订与接纳。 变异智能体被指示做出一个连贯且可测试的更改，该更改需有任务证据支持并具有明确的执行路径。 它会考虑是保留、修改还是回滚上一个更改，并转而采用不同的解释。 更改清单记录所提出的机制、受影响的文件、预测的修复以及面临风险的行为。 调试器报告为修订提供假设。 不存在单独的可选验证阶段。 门控算子接纳已完成的、符合条件的评估，而不要求更高的分数，因此下一个父代可以来自分数较低的修订。 记录算子保存结果和更改证据。 因此，接纳与延续不同于最终冠军报告。

paragraphs.en: Selection and Evidence. HyperAgents permits revision of the improvement procedure as well as the target agent ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Its initial select policy samples eligible Parents using a score-dependent weight and a penalty for having many children. Higher scores increase sampling weight, while the child-count penalty reduces repeated expansion of the same Parent. The rollout operator reuses Parent evaluation traces. The initial analyze operator supplies metrics and browsable raw traces, leaving their interpretation largely to the mutation agent rather than first producing AHE-style debugger reports.
paragraphs.zh: 选择与证据。 HyperAgents 允许对改进过程以及目标智能体进行修订（Zhang et al., 2026c）。 其初始选择策略使用基于分数的权重以及针对拥有多个子节点的惩罚来采样符合条件的父节点。 分数越高，采样权重越大，而子节点数量惩罚则减少对同一父节点的重复扩展。 rollout 算子复用父节点的评估轨迹。 初始分析算子提供指标和可浏览的原始轨迹，将其解读主要留给变异智能体完成，而不是先产出 AHE 风格的调试器报告。

paragraphs.en: Revision and Admission. Mutation may change the target and permitted operator implementations while leaving the evaluator and other fixed contracts unchanged. The mutation instructions favor substantive target changes but allow an operator-only revision when the evidence supports a process-level change. An operator revision takes effect at its next invocation, updating the initial policies in Table 11 for subsequent Generations. The initial validate stage checks Python syntax in target files and the mutation operator. The initial gate admits completed, eligible evaluations without a Parent-relative score threshold. The record operator stores lineage experience, including the Parent, outcome, and score. This editable search procedure distinguishes HyperAgents from target-only revision under fixed operators.
paragraphs.zh: 修订与准入。 变异可以在保持评估器及其他固定契约不变的情况下，改变目标与允许的算子实现。 变异指令偏向实质性的目标变更，但在证据支持过程级变更时也允许仅针对算子的修订。 算子修订在其下一次调用时生效，并为后续世代更新表 11 中的初始策略。 初始校验阶段检查目标文件和变异算子中的 Python 语法。 初始准入接受已完成的、符合条件的评估，不设相对于父代的分数阈值。 记录算子存储谱系经验，包括父代、结果和分数。 这种可编辑的搜索过程将 HyperAgents 与固定算子下仅修订目标的方式区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Selection and Behavioral Feedback. Our A-Evolve implementation operationalizes experience-driven adaptation ( Lin et al., 2026b ) . The select operator chooses the highest-scoring eligible Parent, and rollout collects fresh Train trajectories. The analyze operator compresses observable behavior, including tool use, repeated actions, errors, and completion signals, for a trajectory-only judge. This judge evaluates behavior without benchmark reward labels. Its proxy judgments provide feedback for revision, rather than replacing the benchmark score used for admission.
paragraphs.zh: 选择与行为反馈。 我们的 A-Evolve 实现落地了经验驱动的适应（Lin et al., 2026b）。 选择算子挑选得分最高的合格父智能体，而 rollout 收集新的训练轨迹。 分析算子压缩可观察的行为，包括工具使用、重复动作、错误和完成信号，供仅基于轨迹的评审器使用。 该评审器在不依赖基准奖励标签的情况下评估行为。 它的代理判断为修改提供反馈，而不是取代用于准入的基准分数。

paragraphs.en: Revision and Admission. The mutate operator distills these observations into reusable task-solving guidance and executable target changes. Its instructions emphasize recurrent failure patterns, self-contained skills with their supporting dependencies, and preservation of unrelated behavior. Prompt and skill settings organize revision within the Harness’s legal editing boundary. The optional validate stage is disabled. After canonical evaluation, the strict gate admits a Candidate only if its Validation score exceeds that of the matched Parent. The record operator retains outcomes and the revision rationale. Unlike AHE and the initial HyperAgents policy, A-Evolve combines greedy Parent choice with score-improving admission.
paragraphs.zh: 修订与准入。 mutate 算子将这些观察提炼为可复用的任务求解指导以及可执行的目标变更。 其指令强调反复出现的失败模式、自带支持依赖的独立技能，以及对无关行为的保留。 提示与技能设置将修订限制在 Harness 的合法编辑边界内。 可选的 validate 阶段被禁用。 在规范化评估之后，严格门控只有在候选体的 Validation 得分超过所匹配父体时才准入该候选体。 record 算子保留结果与修订理由。 与 AHE 以及初始超智能体策略不同，A-Evolve 将贪婪的父体选择与得分提升式准入相结合。

paragraphs.en: Selection and Reflection. GEPA combines trajectory-based reflection with per-task Pareto selection ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . The select operator identifies eligible Candidates attaining the best observed score on at least one task, prunes redundant coverage, and samples according to the remaining per-task memberships. This can preserve access to task specialists without selecting solely by aggregate score. The rollout operator collects fresh Train trajectories, and analyze assembles task examples, outputs, and feedback for focused reflection.
paragraphs.zh: 选择与反思。 GEPA 将基于轨迹的反思与逐任务的帕累托选择相结合（Agrawal et al., 2026）。 选择算子识别出在至少一个任务上取得最佳观测分数的合格候选智能体，剪除冗余覆盖，并根据剩余的逐任务成员关系进行采样。 这可以在不完全依据聚合分数进行选择的情况下，保留对任务专家的访问。 rollout 算子收集新的训练轨迹，分析则汇集任务示例、输出和反馈，用于有针对性的反思。

sents.zh: 选择与反思。

sents.zh: GEPA 将基于轨迹的反思与逐任务的帕累托选择相结合（Agrawal et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Revision Scope. The named reflection units differ by benchmark. On τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking, MiniSWE focuses on its system-prompt configuration, while Codex alternates between its prompt and task-execution skill. On Terminal-Bench 2, both harnesses use the entire target as the reflection unit. These units guide evidence organization rather than impose text-only filesystem permissions. The frozen Champion from MiniSWE with GEPA on Terminal-Bench 2 retains inner-source changes to task-conditioned guidance and shell execution. Reflection-centric therefore describes the revision process, not the absence of code changes. These reflection units are distinct from the post-hoc Components isolated in our diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 修订范围。 具名的反思单元因基准测试而异。 在 τ 3 \tau^{3}-Banking 上，MiniSWE 聚焦于其系统提示词配置，而 Codex 则在其提示词与任务执行技能之间交替。 在 Terminal-Bench 2 上，两个测试框架都将整个目标作为反思单元。 这些单元用于引导证据的组织，而非强制施加仅限文本的文件系统权限。 来自 MiniSWE 并在 Terminal-Bench 2 上使用 GEPA 的冻结版冠军保留了对任务条件化引导与 shell 执行的内部源码更改。 因此，“以反思为核心”描述的是修订过程，而非不进行代码更改。 这些反思单元不同于我们诊断中所隔离出的事后组件（Components）。

paragraphs.en: Validation and Admission. The validate operator evaluates the proposal on the same Train task batch used for the Parent rollout and requires a complete, scorable comparison with strict improvement. This feedback-informed proposal filter precedes canonical Validation evaluation. The subsequent gate checks completion and eligibility without imposing a second Parent-relative improvement threshold. The record operator preserves reflection choices, proposals, and batch comparisons. Thus, GEPA’s improvement filter lies in validate , whereas A-Evolve’s lies in gate , and they use different task evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 验证与准入。 validate 算子在用于 Parent 推演的同一 Train 任务批次上评估该提案，并要求得到完整、可打分且具有严格改进的比较结果。 这一基于反馈信息的提案过滤先于规范的验证评估。 随后的 gate 只检查完成度与资格条件，不再施加第二次相对 Parent 的改进阈值。 record 算子保存反思选择、提案以及批次比较结果。 因此，GEPA 的改进过滤器位于 validate，而 A-Evolve 的位于 gate，二者使用的任务证据不同。

sents.zh: 验证与准入。

paragraphs.en: Implications for the Analysis. These implementations differ in how they allocate search, summarize evidence, couple target and operator changes, and filter proposals. Similar final gains can therefore arise through different processes. These differences motivate diagnostics of selection, diagnosis, change compatibility, and admission.
paragraphs.zh: 对分析的启示。 这些实现在如何分配搜索、总结证据、耦合目标与算子变更以及过滤提案方面各不相同。 因此，相似的最终收益可能通过不同的过程产生。 这些差异激发了对选择、诊断、变更兼容性与准入的诊断分析。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation and Interpretation. Every configuration in Table 1 uses the same benchmark tasks and eight complete passes. Each of the eight Champions per benchmark is paired with its harness Seed. The completed comparison contains 7,760 selected τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking executions and 7,120 Terminal-Bench 2 executions, including the two Seeds once per benchmark. Each method–harness–benchmark combination contributes one canonical evolution lineage.

paragraphs.en: Metric Agreement and Disagreement. Across the sixteen Champions, eleven improve reliability and ten improve coverage. Eight improve both, four move the metrics in opposite directions, one improves reliability with unchanged coverage, and three reduce both. The opposite-sign cases occur in reflection-centric general-task evolution and implementation-centric coding-task evolution, each with both harness types. Thus, the distinction between consistency and reach is not confined to one harness type, task domain, or paradigm, even though agreement is more common than disagreement.
paragraphs.zh: 指标一致与不一致。 在十六个冠军（Champions）中，十一个提升了可靠性，十个提升了覆盖度。 八个同时提升两者，四个使指标朝相反方向变动，一个提升了可靠性而覆盖度不变，三个两者均下降。 符号相反的情况出现在以反思为中心的通用任务进化和以实现为中心的编码任务进化中，且每种都涉及两种 harness 类型。 因此，一致性与触达范围的区别并不局限于某一种 harness 类型、任务领域或范式，尽管一致的情况比不一致更为常见。

paragraphs.en: Interpreting Trends Across Dimensions. Reliability improves in all eight implementation-centric lineages across harness types and task domains. In the reflection-centric group, it improves in three of four source-editable cases but none of the four outer-layer-only cases. The paradigm-level pattern is therefore harness-dependent. Recipes also differ in feedback, search, and admission design, suggesting concrete mechanisms for further study.
paragraphs.zh: 跨维度解读趋势。 在八条以实现为核心的谱系中，可靠性在不同测试框架类型和任务领域下均有提升。 在以反思为核心的组别中，四个可编辑源代码的案例中有三个可靠性提升，但四个仅限外层的案例中均无提升。 因此，范式层面的模式依赖于测试框架。 这些配方在反馈、搜索和准入设计上也各不相同，为后续研究提示了具体的机制。

paragraphs.en: Coverage Turnover Across All Settings. All sixteen Champions both gain and lose covered tasks. Gains range from one to fifteen tasks and losses from two to ten, with both types present in every harness–task–paradigm combination. A positive net coverage delta therefore represents the balance of newly covered and lost tasks rather than preservation of the Seed’s solved set. This shared pattern motivates paired gain/loss accounting without requiring a specific method to have the largest net expansion.
paragraphs.zh: 所有设置下的覆盖度更替。 全部十六个Champion都既有新增覆盖任务，也有失去覆盖任务。 增益范围从一到十五个任务，损失范围从二到十个，且每种子 harness–任务–范式组合中都同时存在这两种类型。 因此，正的净覆盖度差值代表新覆盖任务与失去任务之间的平衡，而非对Seed已解决任务集合的保留。 这一共同模式表明应采用成对的增益/损失核算，而不要求某个方法必须拥有最大的净扩展。

paragraphs.en: Within-Task Reliability Also Redistributes. Every panel contains tasks on both sides of the success-count diagonal. Evolution can improve repeated success on already covered tasks, reduce it elsewhere, and change which tasks are covered at all. The shared combination of these movements explains why neither a net coverage gain nor a reliability gain summarizes preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 任务内可靠性同样会重新分布。 每个面板中都包含位于成功次数对角线两侧的任务。 进化可以提高对已被覆盖任务的重复成功次数，降低其他任务的成功次数，并改变哪些任务根本被覆盖。 这些变化的共同作用解释了为什么无论是净覆盖增益还是可靠性增益都无法概括这种保持性。

paragraphs.en: Case Selection and Evidence. We identify the largest positive and negative changes in eight-pass success count within each lineage, breaking ties lexicographically by task identifier before trace inspection. The reported analysis contains 22 task–lineage comparisons with trace-linked behavioral evidence. For each increase, we inspect the first failed Seed execution and the first successful Champion execution in canonical pass order; for each decrease, we inspect the first successful Seed execution and the first failed Champion execution. The audit uses archived actions, observations, submitted artifacts, and verifier records.
paragraphs.zh: 案例选择与证据。 我们在每个谱系内找出八次通过成功次数的最大正向与负向变化，在检视追踪记录之前，先按任务标识符以字典序打破平局。 所报告的分析包含22个任务–谱系对比，并附有与追踪记录关联的行为证据。 对于每次提升，我们按规范的通过顺序检视首次失败的种子执行与首次成功的冠军执行；对于每次下降，我们检视首次成功的种子执行与首次失败的冠军执行。 该审计使用存档的动作、观察结果、提交的产物以及验证器记录。

paragraphs.en: What Changes Behind a Flip. Three themes recur across the selected cases with both harness types, task domains, and evolution paradigms. First, state and dependency management affects the complete workflow. Successful general-task executions order operations so that one preserves the conditions needed by another, while successful coding executions preserve source data before inspection and deliver self-contained artifacts. Second, exact grounding remains fragile after the main workflow succeeds: filed requests can contain an incorrect date, and reconstructed text can contain a single wrong character. Third, intermediate success can fall short of task completion. An agent can open one requested account and stop too early, announce a transfer without completing it, or pass its own program checks while leaving an unacceptable final artifact. These observations motivate checking preserved state, exact arguments, and the final execution boundary alongside the headline success rate. Tool recovery and implementation debugging provide complementary case evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 一次翻转背后发生了什么变化。 在所选案例中，无论 harness 类型、任务领域和演化范式如何，有三个主题反复出现。 第一，状态与依赖管理影响完整的工作流。 成功的通用任务执行会对操作进行排序，使一个操作保留另一个操作所需的条件；成功的编码执行则在检查前先保存源数据，并交付自包含的产物。 第二，在主工作流成功之后，精确落地仍然脆弱：提交的请求可能包含错误的日期，重建的文本可能包含一个错误的字符。 第三，中间环节的成功可能不足以完成任务。 智能体可能开设了所请求的一个账户后过早停止，宣布转账却未完成转账，或者通过了自己程序的检查却留下一个不可接受的最终产物。 这些观察结果促使我们在关注总体成功率的同时，还要检查被保留的状态、精确的参数以及最终的执行边界。 工具恢复与实现调试提供了互补的案例证据。

Superseded attempts remain in the audit ledger but are excluded from deployment accounting.

paragraphs.en: A Frequent Cost Premium, With Structured Exceptions. Eight of the eleven reliability-improving Champions have higher mean deployment cost than Seed. Such premiums occur with both harness types, task domains, and paradigms. All five reliability-improving general-task Champions cost more, whereas three of the six reliability-improving coding-task Champions cost less. The latter comprise two implementation-centric cases and one reflection-centric case, all with the source-editable harness. This harness–task cluster shows how the resource trade-off varies by setting, motivating matched-resource comparisons alongside reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 频繁出现的成本溢价，以及结构化的例外情况。 十一个提升可靠性的冠军智能体（Champions）中，有八个的平均部署成本高于 Seed。 此类溢价在两种测试框架类型、任务领域和范式下均会出现。 五个提升可靠性的通用任务冠军智能体成本都更高，而六个提升可靠性的编码任务冠军智能体中有三个成本更低。 后者包括两个以实现为中心的案例和一个以反思为中心的案例，且均采用可编辑源码的测试框架。 这一测试框架与任务的聚类表明，资源权衡随具体设置而变化，因此在评估可靠性之外还需进行匹配资源的比较。

sents.en: A Frequent Cost Premium, With Structured Exceptions.
sents.zh: 频繁出现的成本溢价，以及结构化的例外情况。

sents.en: Eight of the eleven reliability-improving Champions have higher mean deployment cost than Seed.
sents.zh: 十一个提升可靠性的冠军智能体（Champions）中，有八个的平均部署成本高于 Seed。

sents.en: Such premiums occur with both harness types, task domains, and paradigms.
sents.zh: 此类溢价在两种测试框架类型、任务领域和范式下均会出现。

sents.en: All five reliability-improving general-task Champions cost more, whereas three of the six reliability-improving coding-task Champions cost less.
sents.zh: 五个提升可靠性的通用任务冠军智能体成本都更高，而六个提升可靠性的编码任务冠军智能体中有三个成本更低。

sents.en: The latter comprise two implementation-centric cases and one reflection-centric case, all with the source-editable harness.
sents.zh: 后者包括两个以实现为中心的案例和一个以反思为中心的案例，且均采用可编辑源码的测试框架。

sents.en: This harness–task cluster shows how the resource trade-off varies by setting, motivating matched-resource comparisons alongside reliability.
sents.zh: 这一测试框架与任务的聚类表明，资源权衡随具体设置而变化，因此在评估可靠性之外还需进行匹配资源的比较。

paragraphs.en: Cost and Performance Need Joint Interpretation. All four outer-layer-only Champions on coding tasks cost more than Seed, although only two improve reliability. Coverage–cost curves relate empirical reach to deployment resources at each pass prefix. Evolution cost complements these curves by accounting for the resources used to obtain the evolved agent.
paragraphs.zh: 成本与性能需要联合解读。 在编码任务上，所有四个仅外层优化生成的冠军智能体的成本都高于 Seed，尽管其中只有两个提升了可靠性。 覆盖率–成本曲线将每个 pass 前缀下的经验覆盖范围与部署资源联系起来。 演化成本通过计入获得演化后智能体所消耗的资源，补充了这些曲线。

paragraphs.en: Persistence Across Splits and Harnesses. Ten of sixteen Champions have positive Test reliability contributions. Seven of eight implementation-centric cases improve across both harness types and task domains, with one source-editable general-task exception at − 0.1 -0.1 points. Reflection-centric cases improve in three of four source-editable settings but none of the four outer-layer-only settings. Thus, most implementation-centric gains reach feedback-excluded tasks, while reflection-centric persistence is more harness-dependent. On coding tasks, all outer-layer-only Champions lose Validation reliability, yet the implementation-centric Champions gain Test reliability. Gains therefore vary across splits as well as harness–paradigm combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 跨划分与跨框架的持久性。 十六个冠军智能体中有十个对测试可靠性有正向贡献。 八个以实现为中心的案例中有七个在两种框架类型和任务域上均有所提升，只有一个可编辑源码的通用任务例外，下降 0.1 分。 以反思为中心的案例在四个可编辑源码的设置中有三个有所提升，但在四个仅外层设置中均无提升。 因此，大多数以实现为中心的收益能延续到排除反馈的任务上，而以反思为中心的持久性更依赖框架。 在编码任务上，所有仅外层的冠军智能体都损失了验证可靠性，而以实现为中心的冠军智能体则获得了测试可靠性。 因此，收益在划分之间以及框架—范式组合之间均存在差异。

paragraphs.en: Full-Benchmark Evaluation. The general-task transfer comparison evaluates eight frozen τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking Champions and two harness Seeds on the full τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2026 ) , covering retail, airline, and telecom. Following official benchmark-level aggregation, we compute each metric within each subdomain and take the equal-weight mean across the three subdomains for both Seed and Champion. All 278 tasks have eight valid outcomes per configuration, totaling 22,240 verified evaluations. These measurements supply the absolute scores in Table 14 and matched-Seed gains in Table 3 ; deltas are computed before rounding. Our Pass ​ @ ​ 8 \mathrm{Pass}@8 measures at least one success in eight attempts, while the benchmark’s pass 8 \mathrm{pass}^{8} measures consistency across all eight attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 全基准评测。 通用任务迁移对比在完整 τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench（Barres et al., 2026）上评测了八个冻结的 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking 智能体冠军和两个测试框架种子，涵盖零售、航空和电信领域。 遵循官方的基准级聚合方式，我们对每个子域内分别计算各项指标，并对种子和冠军均取三个子域的等权均值。 全部 278 个任务在每个配置下有八个有效结果，总计 22,240 次经过验证的评测。 这些测量结果提供了表 14 中的绝对分数以及表 3 中的匹配种子增益；差值在四舍五入之前计算。 我们的 Pass ​ @ ​ 8 \mathrm{Pass}@8 衡量的是八次尝试中至少一次成功，而该基准的 pass 8 \mathrm{pass}^{8} 衡量的是全部八次尝试的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Neutral Adaptation and Quality Checks. Within each harness, frozen neutral adapters translate message and tool protocols while preserving target-native user interaction, permissions, state transitions, and verification. All versions share these adapters, with Champion instructions retained unchanged. The evaluation contract fixes task identities, model settings, inference limits, and a score-independent recovery policy. Compatibility checks and smoke tests precede the full evaluation; reporting requires complete valid outcomes under the same contract.
paragraphs.zh: 中立适配与质量检查。 在每个测试框架内，冻结的中立适配器负责转换消息与工具协议，同时保留目标系统原生的用户交互、权限、状态转换和验证机制。 所有版本共享这些适配器，冠军版本（Champion）的指令保持不变。 评估契约固定了任务标识、模型设置、推理限制以及与分数无关的恢复策略。 兼容性检查和冒烟测试先于完整评估进行；报告要求在同一契约下获得完整有效的结果。

paragraphs.en: Coverage Contraction With a Metric-Specific Exception. Seven of eight Champions lose coverage on the general-task transfer target. The sole positive case is reflection-centric and source-editable, at + 1.5 +1.5 points. The recurring contraction spans both harness types and paradigms, while reliability follows a different pattern: all four source-editable Champions improve, and three of four outer-layer-only Champions decline. Thus, more consistent success on the transfer target can coexist with narrower empirical reach, and coverage contraction should not be described as a uniform loss of all benefits.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖范围收缩及针对特定指标的例外情况。 八个冠军（Champions）中有七个在通用任务迁移目标上出现覆盖范围损失。 唯一的正例是以反思为核心且源码可编辑的，提升 +1.5 分。 这种反复出现的收缩跨越了两种测试框架类型和范式，而可靠性则呈现不同的模式：四个源码可编辑的冠军全部提升，四个仅外层修改的冠军中有三个下降。 因此，在迁移目标上更一致的成功可能与更窄的实证覆盖范围并存，覆盖范围收缩不应被描述为对所有收益的统一损失。

sents.zh: 覆盖范围收缩及针对特定指标的例外情况。

paragraphs.en: Frozen Evaluation. DeepSWE v1.1 ( Huang et al., 2026 ) tests transfer from terminal-computing tasks to long-horizon repository-level implementation without target-specific mutation or Champion-specific adaptation. The complete comparison contains four frozen Champions and the matching Seed for each harness, each with 113 official tasks and eight passes, or 904 selected trials per configuration. All 9,040 logical outcomes are complete and unique. Task identities, evaluator and model contracts, inference limits, and recovery rules remain fixed across these versions. Table 14 reports the complete scores for both harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结评估。 DeepSWE v1.1（Huang 等，2026）测试了从终端计算任务到长程仓库级实现任务的迁移，且不进行针对目标的变异或针对冠军智能体的适配。 完整对比包含四个冻结的冠军智能体以及每个测试框架对应的种子智能体，每个配置有113个官方任务和八次通过，即904个筛选出的试验。 全部9,040个逻辑结果均完整且唯一。 任务标识、评估器与模型契约、推理限制以及恢复规则在这些版本中保持固定。 表14报告了两个测试框架的完整得分。

paragraphs.en: A Target-Dependent Reversal Across Paradigms. Seven of eight Champions gain coding-transfer coverage, compared with seven losing coverage on the general-task target. The coding gains span both harness types and paradigms, with one reflection-centric, source-editable exception at − 2.7 -2.7 points. All four source-editable Champions nevertheless lose coding-transfer reliability, by 0.2 0.2 – 2.3 2.3 points, while all four improve it on the general-task target. Outer-layer-only coding-transfer reliability improves in two cases and declines in two. These results separate reach from consistency and show that transfer need not uniformly erode gains.

paragraphs.en: Parent Pools and Common Generation Process. For each benchmark and harness, we form one pool containing the frozen Champions from AHE, HyperAgents, A-Evolve, and GEPA. The four pools contain 16 Parents. Each Parent initializes three separate branches from the same frozen workspace, producing 48 Candidates in total. Every branch uses the same original A-Evolve analyze and mutate implementations, prompts, and generation allowance. The four methods provide Parent artifacts; the shared downstream process holds the modification procedure fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 父池与统一的生成流程。 对于每个基准测试和评测框架，我们构建一个池，其中包含来自 AHE、HyperAgents、A-Evolve 和 GEPA 的冻结冠军智能体。 这四个池共包含 16 个父代。 每个父代从同一个冻结的工作区初始化三个独立分支，总共产生 48 个候选。 每个分支都使用相同的原始 A-Evolve 分析与变异实现、提示词以及生成次数配额。 这四种方法仅提供父代工件；共享的下游流程保持修改过程不变。

paragraphs.en: Execution Evidence and Evaluation. Each Parent executes the 50 Train tasks once, and its three branches share this evidence while running analysis and mutation independently. Canonical Validation uses one pass over 20 tasks on τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking or 19 on Terminal-Bench 2. Each Parent and Candidate receives eight Test passes over 27 or 20 tasks, respectively. Target and mutation models and harness versions follow Section 3.2.1 . Test outcomes determine the reporting scores and best-Parent labels. Candidate scores enter this analysis regardless of the original A-Evolve admission verdict, so the diagnostic measures the changes produced from each Parent.
paragraphs.zh: 执行证据与评估。 每个 Parent 执行一次 50 个 Train 任务，其三个分支共享这些证据，同时独立运行分析与变异。 规范验证（Canonical Validation）对 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking 的 20 个任务或 Terminal-Bench 2 的 19 个任务进行一次完整运行。 每个 Parent 与 Candidate 分别在 27 个或 20 个任务上获得八次 Test 运行。 目标模型、变异模型以及 harness 版本遵循第 3.2.1 节。 Test 结果决定报告的分数与最优 Parent 标签。 Candidate 的分数无论其原始 A-Evolve 准入判定如何都会纳入本分析，因此该诊断衡量的是从每个 Parent 产生的变更。

paragraphs.en: Original Selection Rules. We apply the frozen HyperAgents, A-Evolve, and GEPA select rules to each common four-Parent pool. HyperAgents uses its native score-weighted sampling rule with Train evidence. A-Evolve uses the one-pass Validation aggregate, and GEPA uses the corresponding per-task Validation vector. Diagnostic metadata, child-count initialization, and tie handling are fixed before these rules are evaluated. AHE’s chronological selector requires a shared lineage order, so AHE contributes a Parent artifact and the other three rules define Original. Neither Test outcomes nor sibling Candidate results enter these selection decisions or the analysis and mutation inputs.

paragraphs.en: Comparison Logic. Applying a Component to the matching Seed measures its standalone effect; comparing that variant with Champion tests how the remaining changes affect its benefit. Generic-reminder controls test whether broad guidance reproduces those effects. These comparisons inform analyze through the specificity of useful guidance and mutate through the composition of changes.
paragraphs.zh: 对比逻辑。 将某个组件应用于匹配的种子，可以衡量其独立效果；将该变体与冠军方案进行比较，可以检验其余变更如何影响其收益。 通用提醒对照组用于检验宽泛的指导是否能再现这些效果。 这些对比通过有用指导的具体性为 analyze 提供信息，并通过变更的组合为 mutate 提供依据。

sents.zh: 对比逻辑。

paragraphs.en: A Recurring Specificity Advantage. Fifteen of sixteen Component variants have higher reliability than their matching generic-reminder control, and every Champion case has at least one such Component. The exception is the isolated shell-adaptation Component in the reflection-centric, source-editable coding-task case, at 64.0 versus 65.9 for the reminder; its task-guidance Component instead reaches 67.3. Useful specific changes are therefore not reproduced by general advice, even though not every isolated Component helps. Reminders leave source-editable reliability close to Seed on both task domains and lower outer-layer-only reliability on both.
paragraphs.zh: 反复出现的特异性优势。 十六个组件变体中有十五个的可靠性高于其对应的通用提醒对照，且每个冠军案例都至少包含一个这样的组件。 例外情况是，在以反思为中心、源代码可编辑的编程任务案例中，孤立的 shell 适配组件的可靠性为 64.0，低于提醒的 65.9；但该案例中的任务引导组件达到了 67.3。 因此，有用的具体改动无法被通用建议所复现，尽管并非每个孤立组件都有帮助。 在两个任务领域中，提醒使源代码可编辑的可靠性接近种子水平，并降低了两个领域中仅外层的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Case Composition. The eight Component cases cover both harness types and task domains. Seven are implementation-centric; the reflection-centric case uses the source-editable harness on coding tasks. Each case pairs concrete Champion changes with a generic-reminder intervention on the matching Seed.

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis Requirements. The specificity advantage motivates a diagnosis contract that links failure explanations to execution traces, identifies useful behavior to preserve, and states when the proposed correction applies. We assess this contract through the changes and outcomes it produces.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断要求。 特异性优势促成了一种诊断契约，该契约将故障解释与执行轨迹关联起来，识别值得保留的有用行为，并说明所提出的修正何时适用。 我们通过该契约所产生的变更与结果来评估它。

sents.en: The specificity advantage motivates a diagnosis contract that links failure explanations to execution traces, identifies useful behavior to preserve, and states when the proposed correction applies.
sents.zh: 特异性优势促成了一种诊断契约，该契约将故障解释与执行轨迹关联起来，识别值得保留的有用行为，并说明所提出的修正何时适用。

sents.en: We assess this contract through the changes and outcomes it produces.
sents.zh: 我们通过该契约所产生的变更与结果来评估它。

paragraphs.en: Complete Revisions Usually Outperform Subsets. Six of eight Champions have higher reliability than either isolated Component, including two implementation-centric general-task cases and all four coding-task cases. The exceptions are two other implementation-centric general-task cases, one per harness type: the source-editable interface Component reaches 34.4 versus 32.6 for Champion, and the outer-layer-only orchestration Component reaches 37.2 versus 36.9. In the latter case, skills alone also increase coverage to 72.2 versus 66.0, despite slightly lower reliability. Conversely, an implementation-centric coding-task Champion with the outer-layer-only harness reaches 72.6 reliability even though both isolated variants, at 69.1 and 68.0, fall below Seed’s 69.9. These results motivate evaluating combinations alongside isolated effects.
paragraphs.zh: 完整修订通常优于子集。 八个冠军中有六个的可靠性高于任何孤立的组件，包括两个以实现为中心的通用任务案例以及全部四个编码任务案例。 例外是另外两个以实现为中心的通用任务案例，每个框架类型各一个：可编辑源码接口组件达到 34.4，高于冠军的 32.6；仅外层编排组件达到 37.2，高于冠军的 36.9。 在后一种情况下，仅靠技能也将覆盖率提升至 72.2，高于 66.0，尽管可靠性略低。 相反，一个使用仅外层框架、以实现为中心的编码任务冠军达到 72.6 的可靠性，尽管两个孤立变体分别为 69.1 和 68.0，均低于种子（Seed）的 69.9。 这些结果说明，应当将组合与孤立效应一并加以评估。

paragraphs.en: Compatibility Checks. Interaction estimates use the four verified τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking decompositions, while Terminal-Bench 2 provides targeted subset comparisons. Negative interactions motivate checking whether a Candidate diff follows its diagnosis, includes necessary dependencies, and preserves useful behavior. Coupled changes remain permissible when their dependencies and rationale are explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 兼容性检查。 交互估计使用四个已验证的 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking 分解，而 Terminal-Bench 2 提供针对性的子集比较。 负面交互促使我们检查候选差异（Candidate diff）是否遵循其诊断、包含必要的依赖项，并保留有用的行为。 当耦合变更的依赖关系和理由是明确的时，耦合变更仍然是允许的。
