paragraphs.en: Candidate Pools. For each benchmark, harness, and method, we freeze four distinct artifacts from the same evolution lineage: the Seed, historical Champion, last legal Candidate, and Candidate nearest 50% of cumulative recorded evolution cost. Predeclared 25% and 75% checkpoints resolve duplicates. This gives eight pools per benchmark. Each artifact has eight-pass measurements on separate decision and reporting panels of 20 and 27 tasks for τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking, or 19 and 20 for Terminal-Bench 2. These task panels follow the canonical diagnostic splits.
paragraphs.zh: 候选池。 对于每个基准测试、测试框架和方法，我们从同一条演化谱系中冻结四个不同的产物：种子（Seed）、历史冠军（Champion）、最后一个合法候选体（Candidate），以及累计记录演化成本最接近 50% 的候选体（Candidate）。 预先声明的 25% 和 75% 检查点用于解决重复问题。 这样每个基准测试就有八个池。 每个产物都进行八次通过的测量，在分别包含 20 和 27 个任务（针对 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking）或 19 和 20 个任务（针对 Terminal-Bench 2）的独立决策面板与报告面板上进行。 这些任务面板遵循规范的诊断划分。

sents.en: This is the mean of per-pool ratios, not the ratio of mean hit to mean size.
sents.zh: 这是各池比率的均值，而不是命中均值与大小均值之比。

sents.en: Values are rounded to one decimal place only after aggregation.
sents.zh: 数值仅在聚合之后才四舍五入到小数点后一位。

sents.en: All sixteen pools have a unique empirical best.
sents.zh: 全部十六个池都存在唯一经验最优者。

sents.en: The score therefore equals the chance of drawing that Candidate uniformly from the retained set; this interpretation does not prescribe the method’s actual select policy.
sents.zh: 因此该得分等于从保留集合中均匀抽取该候选（Candidate）的概率；这一解释并不规定方法的实际选择策略。

paragraphs.en: A Recurring Preservation Risk. The original policies retain the reporting-panel best in fifteen pools, compared with six under Constrained. The nine newly excluded best Candidates span both harness types, task domains, and paradigms. Size-normalized scores nevertheless improve in four pools, remain unchanged in three, and fall in nine. The improvements include two implementation-centric source-editable pools retaining the best among fewer alternatives, and two reflection-centric outer-layer-only pools retaining a best Seed alone. Pruning can therefore improve the diagnostic metric while excluding useful Candidates elsewhere. The two outer-layer-only averages increase even while evolved best Candidates are lost in other pools. Jointly reporting hit, set size, and Candidate identity distinguishes concentration on a strong fallback from preservation of evolved gains.
paragraphs.zh: 一种反复出现的保留风险。 原始策略在十五个池中保留了报告面板最佳者，而 Constrained 下只有六个。 新被排除的九个最佳候选（Candidate）横跨两种测试框架类型、任务领域和范式。 尽管如此，按规模归一化的分数在四个池中提升，在三个池中保持不变，在九个池中下降。 这些提升包括两个以实现为中心、源码可编辑的池，它们在更少的备选中保留了最佳者；以及两个以反思为中心、仅外层的池，它们单独保留了一个最佳种子（Seed）。 因此，剪枝在排除其他地方有用候选（Candidate）的同时，仍可能改善诊断指标。 即使在其他池中丢失了进化出的最佳候选（Candidate），两个仅外层的平均值仍在增加。 联合报告命中率、集合大小和候选（Candidate）身份，可以区分对强回退的集中与对进化收益的保留。

paragraphs.en: Replay Evidence and Design Implications. The replay applies original and constrained admission rules to the same frozen Candidate pools and measured scores. The constrained rule combines strict score improvement with a regression cap. Comparing retained-set quality, size, and membership motivates admission rules that balance improvement, preservation, and fallback retention.

paragraphs.en: Case Selection. The matrix contains four Champion cases per benchmark, with two from each harness. Eligibility requires at least two functionally distinct groups of persistent changes that can be isolated with their execution dependencies on the matching Seed while keeping the model and evaluator fixed. The τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking cases comprise Champions from AHE and HyperAgents in both harnesses. On Terminal-Bench 2, we retain the previously evaluated Champions from MiniSWE with AHE and Codex with HyperAgents, and add MiniSWE with GEPA and Codex with AHE after auditing all eight Champions. The additions prioritize clear functional boundaries and complementary mechanisms. Component boundaries were frozen before evaluation, and all completed outcomes are retained.

paragraphs.en: Selection History and Extension. The initial Terminal-Bench 2 sample selected the largest historical unrounded Avg ​ @ ​ 8 \mathrm{Avg}@8 gain within each harness, yielding MiniSWE with AHE and Codex with HyperAgents. Case identities remain frozen, and source-faithful reevaluations replace the two superseded Codex Champion measurements. MiniSWE with GEPA separates task guidance from shell execution adaptation, complementing AHE’s broader validation and submission controls. Codex with AHE separates instruction content from persistent context and skill support, complementing HyperAgents’ dependency bootstrap. Functional clarity and mechanism complementarity determine the additions. Their identities and Component boundaries were frozen before evaluation, and all added outcomes are reported.
paragraphs.zh: 选择历史与扩展。 最初的 Terminal-Bench 2 样本在每个 harness 内选择历史上最大的未取整 Avg @ 8 增益，得到搭载 AHE 的 MiniSWE 与搭载 HyperAgents 的 Codex。 案例身份保持冻结，忠于原始来源的重新评估替换了两个被取代的 Codex Champion 测量结果。 搭载 GEPA 的 MiniSWE 将任务指导与 shell 执行适配分离，与 AHE 更广泛的验证与提交控制形成互补。 搭载 AHE 的 Codex 将指令内容与持久上下文及技能支持分离，与 HyperAgents 的依赖引导形成互补。 功能清晰性与机制互补性决定了这些新增项。 它们的身份与组件边界在评估前已冻结，且所有新增结果均予以报告。

paragraphs.en: Component A: Interface. This Component changes how shell/tool output is presented to the model, while retaining the Seed’s task-solving instructions and bash action interface. It extracts readable text from structured tool-response envelopes, removes duplicate text blocks, and preserves salient information when an observation is long. Rather than retaining only its beginning and end, the observation also includes a bounded selection of middle content containing tool schemas, execution results, required fields, and conversation-control signals. The changed files are models/utils/actions_toolcall.py , models/utils/actions_toolcall_response.py , the added models/utils/observation_output.py , and the observation_template key in config/mini.yaml .
paragraphs.zh: 组件 A：界面。 该组件改变 shell/工具输出呈现给模型的方式，同时保留 Seed 的任务求解指令与 bash 动作接口。 它从结构化的工具响应信封中提取可读文本，删除重复的文本块，并在观测内容较长时保留显著信息。 观测内容并不仅保留开头和结尾，还包括一个有界选取的中间内容，其中包含工具模式、执行结果、必需字段以及对话控制信号。 修改的文件是 models/utils/actions_toolcall.py、models/utils/actions_toolcall_response.py、新增的 models/utils/observation_output.py，以及 config/mini.yaml 中的 observation_template 键。

paragraphs.en: Component B: Strategy. This Component replaces the system prompt, task prompt, and format-error guidance in config/mini.yaml ; observation processing stays at the Seed. The instructions distinguish the benchmark’s tool-driven general tasks from coding tasks, prioritize live state and tool schemas, require one focused action followed by inspection, prohibit invented arguments or case facts, and distinguish a stopped conversation from a successfully completed backend action. The format-error guidance also specifies concise recovery from token-limit truncation and a tool-only final submission.
paragraphs.zh: 组件 B：策略。 该组件替换 config/mini.yaml 中的系统提示词、任务提示词和格式错误指导；观察处理仍保留在 Seed 中。 该指导区分了基准测试中由工具驱动的通用任务与编码任务，优先考虑实时状态和工具模式，要求执行一个聚焦动作后进行检查，禁止编造参数或用例事实，并区分已停止的对话与已成功完成的后端操作。 格式错误指导还规定了从 token 上限截断中简洁恢复的方式，以及仅通过工具进行最终提交的要求。

paragraphs.en: Task-prompt excerpt: “Prefer live environment state, exact tool outputs, runtime status, and tool schemas over inference from general KB text.”

paragraphs.en: Completion-rule excerpt: “Only treat the task as complete when the required environment state or required action has actually been achieved.”

paragraphs.en: Component A: Interface. This Component exposes structured benchmark tools in place of a bash-only interface when it detects tasks from the general-task benchmark. It adds tool schemas, argument parsing (including nested JSON-string normalization), dispatch to the benchmark environment, and a dedicated final-submission action. The dependency-closed implementation spans agents/interactive.py , environments/local.py , utils/tau3.py , both action/tool-response utilities, and seven adapters in models/ : the chat and Responses implementations for LiteLLM, OpenRouter, and Portkey, plus Requesty. The thirteenth changed file, config/mini.yaml , adds neutral transport and format-error instructions so that the Seed prompt does not request an unavailable bash tool. This compatibility text describes how to call the exposed tools, without importing the Champion’s task-solving strategy.

paragraphs.en: Component B: Strategy. This Component changes only the task-instance prompt in config/mini.yaml . It retains the Champion’s service workflow: start the conversation once, consult the latest user message and schema, perform one action at a time, separate user communication from domain-tool calls, respect stop/transfer signals, and ground advice in documented policy and hard user requirements. Because the Seed does not expose Component A’s structured tools, the workflow is expressed through the Seed’s tau3-mcp.py command-line interface. This is the evaluated CLI-translated strategy Component, not an unmodified copy of the native-tool prompt; the translation is an execution dependency, not an independent strategy finding.

paragraphs.en: Component B: Prompt and Skills. This Component replaces prompt.md and skills/task-execution/SKILL.md , and adds skills/tau3-service-workflows/SKILL.md , while retaining the Seed adapter. The prompt distinguishes coding work from the general-task benchmark’s workflows and directs the latter to the specialized skill. That skill specifies a six-part workflow: discover the live tool surface; ground on the exact entity; identify who must perform the next state change; construct exact writes; preserve the selected product or workflow branch; and finish all requested work. It includes explicit checks for relative dates, enums, optional fields, user-side follow-through, and multi-item completion.
paragraphs.zh: 组件 B：提示词与技能。 该组件替换 prompt.md 和 skills/task-execution/SKILL.md，并新增 skills/tau3-service-workflows/SKILL.md，同时保留 Seed 适配器。 该提示词区分编码工作与通用任务基准的工作流，并将后者导向专用技能。 该技能规定了一个六部分工作流：发现实际可用的工具面；锚定确切实体；确定必须由谁执行下一个状态变更；构建精确写入；保留所选产品或工作流分支；以及完成所有被请求的工作。 它包含对相对日期、枚举、可选字段、用户侧后续操作以及多事项完成的显式检查。

paragraphs.zh: 提示词摘录：“如果任务涉及多个被请求的操作或实体，请保留一份简短的核对清单，并在任何被请求的项目尚未完成时不要结束。”

paragraphs.en: Component A: Orchestration. The outer agent.py detects the configured service server or service markers in the instruction, then prepends a guidance block unless its header is already present. The same server-detection helper is reused by the existing installation path. The injected guidance prioritizes live account investigation, eligible and actionable recommendations, exact knowledge-base procedures, discoverable-tool checks, literal argument formatting, and completion of accepted workflows. Prompt and skill files remain at the Seed, so the specialized-skill reference in this block does not itself install Component B.
paragraphs.zh: 组件 A：编排。 外层的 agent.py 会检测指令中配置的服务服务器或服务标记，然后在其标头尚未存在时前置一个引导块。 同一个服务器检测辅助函数会被现有的安装路径复用。 注入的引导优先考虑实时账户调查、符合条件且可操作的建议、确切的知识库流程、可发现工具的检查、字面参数格式化，以及已完成工作流的收尾。 提示词与技能文件仍保留在 Seed 处，因此该块中的专用技能引用本身并不会安装组件 B。

If the KB names a dedicated replacement, approval, closure, report, or submission tool, use that exact tool instead of assuming another mutation already covered it.”

paragraphs.en: Component B: Skills. This Component changes skills/task-execution/SKILL.md to route tasks from the general-task benchmark to the added skills/tau3-banking-runtime/SKILL.md ; the outer adapter and main prompt stay at the Seed. The specialized skill covers identity verification, account-specific lookups, recommendation eligibility, tool unlocking and execution checks, multi-step discrepancies, transfers, closures, and final-state verification. It also includes implementation-sensitive payload rules: preserve surfaced key order, whitespace, explicit null/false values, and numeric forms in nested argument strings. These are actual retained instructions, not a claim that equivalent JSON representations generally have different semantics.

paragraphs.en: Component A: Static Instructions. Only config/mini.yaml changes. The retained prompt additions call for early inspection of visible tests and checkers, exact deliverable paths and formats, fresh-shell verification, preservation of original inputs and consumers, and rechecking after any subsequent change. They reject proxy checks, fabricated substitutes, and unresolved failures as evidence of completion. These instructions do not add a programmatic submission guard.
paragraphs.zh: 组件 A：静态指令。 仅修改 config/mini.yaml。 保留的提示词增补要求尽早检查可见的测试与检查器、确切的交付物路径与格式、在新 shell 中进行验证、保留原始输入及其使用方，并在任何后续更改后重新检查。 这些指令拒绝将代理检查、伪造的替代品和未解决的失败作为完成的证据。 这些指令未添加程序化的提交防护。

paragraphs.en: Contract-first instruction: “Before long implementation, downloads, or external research, spend the first 1-2 commands locating the real acceptance path.”

paragraphs.en: Reverification instruction: “Any edit after a passing verification invalidates that verification. If you change the artifact, environment, dependency set, or generated output afterward, rerun the exact end-to-end check against the final state before submitting.”

paragraphs.en: Component B: Dynamic Guard. Files agents/default.py and environments/local.py implement the dynamic checks. The configuration file config/mini.yaml supplies their hooks and activation flags, without Component A’s static instructions. It discovers visible verifier files, derives deliverable-boundary hints from the task, supplies fresh-shell compatibility helpers, records test inspection and unresolved check failures, and inspects submission attempts. The guard can replace a completion signal with a warning about uninspected verifiers, unhealthy package state, unresolved failures, missing files, or deliverable-boundary violations. It warns once per warning fingerprint; repeating the same submission can proceed, so this is not an unconditional veto or a replacement for the benchmark evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: 组件 B：动态守卫。 文件 agents/default.py 和 environments/local.py 实现了动态检查。 配置文件 config/mini.yaml 提供它们的钩子和激活标志，而不包含组件 A 的静态指令。 它会发现可见的验证器文件，从任务中推导交付物边界提示，提供全新 shell 的兼容性辅助，记录测试检查和未解决的检查失败，并检查提交尝试。 该守卫可以用一条警告替换完成信号，警告内容涉及未检查的验证器、不健康的包状态、未解决的失败、缺失的文件或交付物边界违规。 它对每个警告指纹只警告一次；重复提交相同内容可以继续进行，因此这不是无条件否决，也不是对基准评估器的替代。

paragraphs.en: Component A: Task Guidance. This Component combines static instructions about exact deliverables and evidence preservation with task-conditioned reminders. In agents/default.py , _build_task_guardrails detects wording associated with exhaustive outputs or fragile evidence and generates the corresponding guidance. The template in config/mini.yaml consumes the generated task_guardrails value and includes the accompanying static instructions. The generator and template hook stay in the same Component because either alone disconnects the mechanism. The local command-execution implementation remains at the Seed.

The helper _preferred_shell_executable resolves MSWEA_LOCAL_SHELL , defaulting to bash , and supplies the available executable to the subprocess launcher. This changes shell semantics at the command-execution boundary without importing Component A’s guidance or changing the model configuration.

paragraphs.en: Component A: Prompt and Skills. This Component replaces the prompt and task-execution skill in prompt.md and skills/task-execution/SKILL.md . The instructions prioritize the verifier-facing contract, a minimal coherent change on the active execution path, and checks of the final artifact at the consumer-visible boundary. Prompt and skill content form one guidance Component rather than separate Components based on file location. The adapter, compaction settings, model, reasoning effort, and Codex executable remain at the Seed.

paragraphs.en: Component B: Persistent Context and Skill Support. The outer agent.py moves temporary Codex state and skill-upload paths to a persistent Codex directory, while codex.toml enables prefix-preserving compaction with auto_compact_token_limit_scope set to body_after_prefix . These changes support instruction continuity without importing Component A’s prompt or skill contents. The evolved adapter changes are semantically applied to the exact evaluation Seed, preserving its authentication, provider routing, session handling, and cancellation cleanup. Codex’s executable and source, the model, and reasoning effort are unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 组件 B：持久化上下文与技能支持。 外层的 agent.py 将临时的 Codex 状态和技能上传路径迁移到持久化的 Codex 目录，同时 codex.toml 通过将 auto_compact_token_limit_scope 设置为 body_after_prefix 来启用保留前缀的压缩。 这些改动在不引入组件 A 的提示词或技能内容的情况下，支持指令的连续性。 演化后的适配器变更在语义上精确应用于评估 Seed，保留其身份验证、提供商路由、会话处理以及取消清理逻辑。 Codex 的可执行文件与源代码、模型以及推理力度均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Component B: Orchestration and Bootstrap. Only the outer agent.py changes. The Champion’s bootstrap changes are merged onto the exact Seed adapter used in the matched evaluation, rather than replacing that adapter with a different baseline wrapper. During setup, the adapter installs or locates uv and uvx , creates a sourceable environment helper, and exposes stable executable entrypoints in standard locations for fresh-shell verifier commands. Installation first attempts the Python package route and then an installer fallback; setup reports a warning if the bootstrap remains unavailable. The Seed’s prompt and skills are retained. This Component prepares the execution environment; it does not alter the verifier’s scoring rules or Codex’s executable.
paragraphs.zh: 组件B：编排与引导（Bootstrap）。 只有外层的 agent.py 会发生变化。 冠军的引导（bootstrap）改动会合并到匹配评测中使用的同一个种子（Seed）适配器上，而不是用另一个基线包装器替换该适配器。 在设置过程中，适配器会安装或定位 uv 和 uvx，创建一个可 source 的环境辅助脚本，并在标准位置暴露稳定的可执行入口点，以供全新 shell 中的验证器命令使用。 安装首先尝试 Python 包的途径，然后回退到安装器；如果引导（bootstrap）仍然不可用，设置会报告一条警告。 种子（Seed）的提示词和技能将被保留。 该组件负责准备执行环境；它不会更改验证器的评分规则或 Codex 的可执行文件。

paragraphs.en: Recovery of Interrupted Evaluations. Four τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking Codex reminder evaluations were interrupted by API rate limits after their conversations had started. Under a documented recovery-policy amendment, we fixed these four task–pass identities and reran each once from its initial state with unchanged model, simulator, target, and evaluator settings. The other 772 numeric outcomes were retained, and all four replacement outcomes were accepted, including three zeros. Original attempts remain in the audit record; selected outcomes and their costs enter the reported metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 中断评估的恢复。 四次 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking Codex 提醒评估在其对话开始后被 API 速率限制中断。 根据一项有记录的恢复策略修订，我们固定了这四个任务–通过身份，并在模型、模拟器、目标和评估器设置均不变的情况下，各自从其初始状态重新运行一次。 其余 772 个数值结果予以保留，四个替换结果均被采纳，其中包括三个零。 原始尝试仍保留在审计记录中；选定的结果及其成本计入所报告的指标。

sents.en: Recovery of Interrupted Evaluations.
sents.zh: 中断评估的恢复。

sents.en: Four τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking Codex reminder evaluations were interrupted by API rate limits after their conversations had started.
sents.zh: 四次 τ 3 \tau^{3} -Banking Codex 提醒评估在其对话开始后被 API 速率限制中断。

sents.en: Under a documented recovery-policy amendment, we fixed these four task–pass identities and reran each once from its initial state with unchanged model, simulator, target, and evaluator settings.
sents.zh: 根据一项有记录的恢复策略修订，我们固定了这四个任务–通过身份，并在模型、模拟器、目标和评估器设置均不变的情况下，各自从其初始状态重新运行一次。

sents.en: The other 772 numeric outcomes were retained, and all four replacement outcomes were accepted, including three zeros.
sents.zh: 其余 772 个数值结果予以保留，四个替换结果均被采纳，其中包括三个零。

sents.en: Original attempts remain in the audit record; selected outcomes and their costs enter the reported metrics.
sents.zh: 原始尝试仍保留在审计记录中；选定的结果及其成本计入所报告的指标。

paragraphs.en: The analysis agent combines results from the Phenomenology, Generalization, and Mechanisms analyses with source traces and reference operators. It identifies recurring patterns across harnesses, task domains, and evolution paradigms and links each finding to the relevant comparisons and observed behavior. The resulting evidence report supplies the rationale and applicability conditions for operator revision.
paragraphs.zh: 分析智能体将现象学、泛化与机制分析的结果与源码追踪及参考算子相结合。 它识别跨测试框架、任务领域和演化范式中反复出现的模式，并将每项发现与相关比较及观察到的行为关联起来。 所生成的证据报告为算子修订提供依据和适用条件。

sents.en: The analysis agent combines results from the Phenomenology, Generalization, and Mechanisms analyses with source traces and reference operators.
sents.zh: 分析智能体将现象学、泛化与机制分析的结果与源码追踪及参考算子相结合。

sents.en: It identifies recurring patterns across harnesses, task domains, and evolution paradigms and links each finding to the relevant comparisons and observed behavior.
sents.zh: 它识别跨测试框架、任务领域和演化范式中反复出现的模式，并将每项发现与相关比较及观察到的行为关联起来。

sents.en: The resulting evidence report supplies the rationale and applicability conditions for operator revision.
sents.zh: 所生成的证据报告为算子修订提供依据和适用条件。

paragraphs.en: Each proposed revision specifies the original rule, observed problem, implementation change, expected effect, and validation checks. The implementation agent receives this specification together with the evidence report, reference code, input/output contract, and permitted editing surface. It returns versioned code or instructions, evidence links, applicability conditions, fallback behavior, and validation records. Interface checks preserve the reference rollout , validate , and record stages and each harness’s editing contract.
paragraphs.zh: 每项提出的修订都指明原始规则、观察到的问题、实现变更、预期效果以及验证检查。 实现智能体会收到该规范，连同证据报告、参考代码、输入/输出契约以及允许编辑的范围。 它返回带版本号的代码或指令、证据链接、适用条件、回退行为以及验证记录。 接口检查保留参考的 rollout、validate 和 record 阶段以及每个测试框架的编辑契约。

sents.en: Each proposed revision specifies the original rule, observed problem, implementation change, expected effect, and validation checks.
sents.zh: 每项提出的修订都指明原始规则、观察到的问题、实现变更、预期效果以及验证检查。

sents.en: The implementation agent receives this specification together with the evidence report, reference code, input/output contract, and permitted editing surface.
sents.zh: 实现智能体会收到该规范，连同证据报告、参考代码、输入/输出契约以及允许编辑的范围。

sents.en: It returns versioned code or instructions, evidence links, applicability conditions, fallback behavior, and validation records.
sents.zh: 它返回带版本号的代码或指令、证据链接、适用条件、回退行为以及验证记录。

sents.en: Interface checks preserve the reference rollout , validate , and record stages and each harness’s editing contract.
sents.zh: 接口检查保留参考的 rollout、validate 和 record 阶段以及每个测试框架的编辑契约。

paragraphs.en: Diagnosis and Mutation Requirements. The analyze revision asks diagnoses to identify the observed failure and useful behavior to preserve. The mutate revision asks Candidate changes to implement that diagnosis coherently and retain the required dependencies. These complementary contracts connect execution evidence to the resulting intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断与变更要求。 analyze 修订要求诊断识别观察到的失败以及需要保留的有用行为。 mutate 修订要求 Candidate 的变更连贯地实现该诊断，并保留所需的依赖关系。 这些互补的约定将执行证据与最终产生的干预联系起来。

sents.en: Diagnosis and Mutation Requirements.
sents.zh: 诊断与变更要求。

sents.en: The analyze revision asks diagnoses to identify the observed failure and useful behavior to preserve.
sents.zh: analyze 修订要求诊断识别观察到的失败以及需要保留的有用行为。

sents.en: The mutate revision asks Candidate changes to implement that diagnosis coherently and retain the required dependencies.
sents.zh: mutate 修订要求 Candidate 的变更连贯地实现该诊断，并保留所需的依赖关系。

sents.en: These complementary contracts connect execution evidence to the resulting intervention.
sents.zh: 这些互补的约定将执行证据与最终产生的干预联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Revision Objectives. The four revisions in Table 8 target complementary decisions. Regression-aware select uses preservation evidence to resolve score ties, behavior-grounded analyze links diagnoses to execution traces, dependency-aware mutate organizes coherent changes, and cost-aware gate considers resource use at equal scores. These objectives guide implementation, expert review, and algorithm evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 修订目标。 表 8 中的四项修订针对互补的决策。 回归感知的选择利用保留证据来解决分数平局，行为锚定的分析将诊断与执行轨迹关联起来，依赖感知的变异组织连贯的变更，而成本感知的门控则在分数相同时考虑资源使用。 这些目标指导实现、专家评审和算法评估。

sents.en: Revision Objectives.
sents.zh: 修订目标。

sents.en: The four revisions in Table 8 target complementary decisions.
sents.zh: 表 8 中的四项修订针对互补的决策。

sents.en: Regression-aware select uses preservation evidence to resolve score ties, behavior-grounded analyze links diagnoses to execution traces, dependency-aware mutate organizes coherent changes, and cost-aware gate considers resource use at equal scores.
sents.zh: 回归感知的选择利用保留证据来解决分数平局，行为锚定的分析将诊断与执行轨迹关联起来，依赖感知的变异组织连贯的变更，而成本感知的门控则在分数相同时考虑资源使用。

sents.en: These objectives guide implementation, expert review, and algorithm evaluation.
sents.zh: 这些目标指导实现、专家评审和算法评估。

paragraphs.en: Eight experts independently reviewed all four frozen operator revisions, with balanced case and direction-option orders. For each case, they inspected the original rule and evidence and submitted a direction before seeing EvoAudit’s proposal. They then reviewed its reasoning, implementation changes, applicability, and validation plan, judging evidence support, problem addressing, and approval to validate. Each question included an insufficient-evidence option and optional comments. Figures 8 and 9 show the direction-selection and proposal-review interfaces for the select revision.
paragraphs.zh: 八位专家独立评审了全部四个冻结的算子版本，案例顺序和方向选项顺序均作了平衡处理。 对于每个案例，他们先查看原始规则和证据，并在看到EvoAudit的提案之前提交一个方向。 随后他们审查其推理、实现改动、适用性和验证计划，评判证据支持度、是否解决该问题以及是否批准进入验证。 每个问题均包含“证据不足”选项和可选的评论。 图8和图9展示了所选版本的方向选择界面和提案评审界面。

sents.en: Eight experts independently reviewed all four frozen operator revisions, with balanced case and direction-option orders.
sents.zh: 八位专家独立评审了全部四个冻结的算子版本，案例顺序和方向选项顺序均作了平衡处理。

sents.en: For each case, they inspected the original rule and evidence and submitted a direction before seeing EvoAudit’s proposal.
sents.zh: 对于每个案例，他们先查看原始规则和证据，并在看到EvoAudit的提案之前提交一个方向。

sents.en: They then reviewed its reasoning, implementation changes, applicability, and validation plan, judging evidence support, problem addressing, and approval to validate.
sents.zh: 随后他们审查其推理、实现改动、适用性和验证计划，评判证据支持度、是否解决该问题以及是否批准进入验证。

sents.en: Each question included an insufficient-evidence option and optional comments.
sents.zh: 每个问题均包含“证据不足”选项和可选的评论。

sents.en: Figures 8 and 9 show the direction-selection and proposal-review interfaces for the select revision.
sents.zh: 图8和图9展示了所选版本的方向选择界面和提案评审界面。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 reports mean positive counts per revision out of eight experts. Direction agreement uses a frozen mapping between the initial choice and EvoAudit’s direction. Evidence support and problem addressing count fully positive responses, while endorsement counts approval to validate without further changes. Each measure sums positive counts across the four revisions and divides by four. Assignments, proposal versions, questions, and aggregation rules were frozen before formal review. All formal judgments are retained, and subsequent changes receive new proposal versions.
paragraphs.zh: 表9报告了八位专家在每次修订中的平均正向计数。 方向一致性采用初始选择与EvoAudit方向之间的冻结映射。 证据支持和问题解决统计完全正向的回答，而认可则统计无需进一步修改即可通过验证的批准。 每项指标将四次修订的正向计数相加并除以四。 分配、提案版本、问题以及聚合规则在正式评审前均已冻结。 所有正式判定均予保留，后续更改将获得新的提案版本。

sents.en: Table 9 reports mean positive counts per revision out of eight experts.
sents.zh: 表9报告了八位专家在每次修订中的平均正向计数。

sents.en: Direction agreement uses a frozen mapping between the initial choice and EvoAudit’s direction.
sents.zh: 方向一致性采用初始选择与EvoAudit方向之间的冻结映射。

sents.en: Evidence support and problem addressing count fully positive responses, while endorsement counts approval to validate without further changes.
sents.zh: 证据支持和问题解决统计完全正向的回答，而认可则统计无需进一步修改即可通过验证的批准。

sents.en: Each measure sums positive counts across the four revisions and divides by four.
sents.zh: 每项指标将四次修订的正向计数相加并除以四。

sents.en: Assignments, proposal versions, questions, and aggregation rules were frozen before formal review.
sents.zh: 分配、提案版本、问题以及聚合规则在正式评审前均已冻结。

sents.en: All formal judgments are retained, and subsequent changes receive new proposal versions.
sents.zh: 所有正式判定均予保留，后续更改将获得新的提案版本。

paragraphs.en: We compare archived 20-generation runs of AHE, HyperAgents, A-Evolve, and GEPA with separate 20-generation AGE runs on both primary benchmarks and harnesses. Each frozen Champion receives eight benchmark passes against its matching Seed. Table 10 reports reliability, coverage, task turnover, and deployment and evolution costs. Evidence-collection and analysis/design-agent costs are recorded separately from online evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 AHE、HyperAgents、A-Evolve 和 GEPA 的存档 20 代运行结果，与在主要基准测试和测试框架上单独进行的 20 代 AGE 运行结果进行比较。 每个冻结的冠军智能体（Champion）都要针对其匹配的种子（Seed）进行八次基准测试。 表 10 报告了可靠性、覆盖率、任务更替率以及部署与演化成本。 证据收集以及分析/设计智能体的成本与在线演化成本分开记录。

sents.en: We compare archived 20-generation runs of AHE, HyperAgents, A-Evolve, and GEPA with separate 20-generation AGE runs on both primary benchmarks and harnesses.
sents.zh: 我们将 AHE、HyperAgents、A-Evolve 和 GEPA 的存档 20 代运行结果，与在主要基准测试和测试框架上单独进行的 20 代 AGE 运行结果进行比较。

sents.en: Each frozen Champion receives eight benchmark passes against its matching Seed.
sents.zh: 每个冻结的冠军智能体（Champion）都要针对其匹配的种子（Seed）进行八次基准测试。

sents.en: Table 10 reports reliability, coverage, task turnover, and deployment and evolution costs.
sents.zh: 表 10 报告了可靠性、覆盖率、任务更替率以及部署与演化成本。

sents.en: Evidence-collection and analysis/design-agent costs are recorded separately from online evolution.
sents.zh: 证据收集以及分析/设计智能体的成本与在线演化成本分开记录。

paragraphs.en: The following figures show all sixteen archived evolution runs, each comprising the Seed and 20 generation attempts. Unsuccessful attempts are retained. Arrows follow the recorded parent-to-child relationships, not chronological adjacency; layout positions and node colors do not indicate performance or acceptance decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 以下各图展示了全部十六次存档的演化运行，每次运行均包含种子（Seed）以及 20 代尝试。 未成功的尝试均予保留。 箭头遵循记录中的亲代到子代关系，而非时间上的相邻顺序；布局位置与节点颜色不代表性能或接受与否的决定。
